title.zh: 卷98 志七十三 乐五 乐章三 筵宴乡饮酒
title.en: Volume 98 Treatises 73: Music 5, Yue Zhangsan, Yan Yan Xiang Yin Jiu
title.raw: 卷98 志七十三 乐五 乐章三 筵宴乡饮酒

sentences.zh: 志七十三

translations.literal: Treatise seventy-three.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 73.

sentences.zh: 樂五

translations.literal: Music, section five.
translations.idiomatic: Music V.

sentences.zh: 太和殿閱皇太后徽號冊寶，海上蟠桃一章乾隆七年定。

translations.literal: At the Hall of Supreme Harmony, upon viewing the Empress Dowager's honorific title, seal register, and imperial credentials: one stanza, "Peach of the Eastern Sea," fixed in the seventh year of the Qianlong reign.
translations.idiomatic: For the ceremony at the Hall of Supreme Harmony when the Empress Dowager's honorific title, register, and credentials were presented: one movement, "Peach upon the Eastern Sea," established in Qianlong 7.

sentences.zh: 中和清樂

translations.literal: Clear music of the Zhonghe ensemble.
translations.idiomatic: Zhonghe Clear Music.

sentences.zh: 海上蟠桃乍熟，日邊紅杏初芳，慈幃履慶承天貺，景福正綿長。

translations.literal: The peach upon the sea has just ripened; beside the sun, red apricots first bloom. The compassionate curtain treads celebration, receiving Heaven's gift; splendid blessings run ever long.
translations.idiomatic: The sea-borne peach has just ripened; sunlit apricots first unfold their bloom. Beneath the gracious canopy, joy receives Heaven's bounty; radiant fortune stretches without end.

sentences.zh: 一解啟蓬萊，排仙仗，露漙漙，凝仙掌，褘衣翟服爛明璫。

translations.literal: First stanza: open Penglai; array the immortal guard; dew drips thick; condense upon the immortal palm; ceremonial robes and pheasant garments blaze with bright pendants.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza I: Penglai opens; immortal ranks deploy; dew beads thick; it gathers on the jade palm; state robes and pheasant regalia flash with jeweled pendants.

sentences.zh: 耀金鋪，日擁扶桑。

translations.literal: Glittering gold spreads; the sun embraces Fusang.
translations.idiomatic: Gold gleams across the hall; the sun embraces the sacred tree of the east.

sentences.zh: 喜風和駘蕩，爐熏百和香，太平有象，孝德光昌。

translations.literal: Joy: gentle winds blow soft; censer smoke, a hundred blended fragrances; the age of Great Peace has its sign; filial virtue shines bright and flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: With joy the breeze blows mild; incense of a hundred blends rises from the brazier; the age bears the signs of peace; filial virtue shines in splendor.

sentences.zh: 二解殿當中，雲光瀁，駕臨軒，金閨敞，孝思不匱重天常。

translations.literal: Second stanza: the hall at center; cloud-light ripples; the imperial carriage approaches the portico; golden inner chambers open wide; filial thought unceasing honors Heaven's constant way.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza II: at the hall's center cloud-light ripples; the throne approaches the forecourt; golden chambers stand open wide; unceasing filial devotion upholds Heaven's eternal order.

sentences.zh: 展瑤函，寶冊輝煌。

translations.literal: Unfold the jade casket; the precious register blazes in splendor.
translations.idiomatic: The jade case opens; the precious register blazes with glory.

sentences.zh: 喜風和駘蕩，爐熏百和香。

translations.literal: Joy: gentle winds blow soft; censer smoke, a hundred blended fragrances.
translations.idiomatic: With joy the breeze blows mild; incense of a hundred blends rises from the brazier.

sentences.zh: 太平有象，孝德光昌。

translations.literal: The age of Great Peace has its sign; filial virtue shines bright and flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: The age bears the signs of peace; filial virtue shines in splendor.

sentences.zh: 三解紫霞杯，葡萄釀，九華鐙，芙蓉桁，流霞紺雪酌天漿。

translations.literal: Third stanza: purple-cloud cups; grape wine brewed; nine-flower lamps; lotus crossbeams; flowing rosy clouds, dark snow—pour the celestial nectar.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza III: cups of purple mist; wine of the grape; lamps of nine blossoms; lotus beams; rosy clouds and pale frost—pour the nectar of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 頌期頤，地久天長。

translations.literal: Praise the fullness of years; earth long, heaven enduring.
translations.idiomatic: We praise a life fulfilled; may earth endure and heaven last forever.

sentences.zh: 喜風和駘蕩，爐熏百和香。

translations.literal: Joy: gentle winds blow soft; censer smoke, a hundred blended fragrances.
translations.idiomatic: With joy the breeze blows mild; incense of a hundred blends rises from the brazier.

sentences.zh: 太平有象，孝德光昌。

translations.literal: The age of Great Peace has its sign; filial virtue shines bright and flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: The age bears the signs of peace; filial virtue shines in splendor.

sentences.zh: 四解玉衡平，金波朗，湛露融，階蓂長，雲璈法曲奏清商。

translations.literal: Fourth stanza: the jade armillary level; golden waves bright; deep dew melts; rank-birthwort on the steps grows long; cloud-gongs and ritual melodies play the Qing Shang mode.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza IV: the jade balance stands level; golden light runs clear; heavy dew melts away; auspicious plants lengthen on the steps; cloud-gongs and court airs play in the clear Shang mode.

sentences.zh: 奉慈徽，長信傳芳。

translations.literal: Present the compassionate emblem; Changxin transmits its fragrance.
translations.idiomatic: We offer the emblem of grace; Changxin's fragrance endures through the ages.

sentences.zh: 喜風和駘蕩，爐熏百和香。

translations.literal: Joy: gentle winds blow soft; censer smoke, a hundred blended fragrances.
translations.idiomatic: With joy the breeze blows mild; incense of a hundred blends rises from the brazier.

sentences.zh: 太平有象，孝德光昌。

translations.literal: The age of Great Peace has its sign; filial virtue shines bright and flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: The age bears the signs of peace; filial virtue shines in splendor.

sentences.zh: 五解萬方玉食尊親養，孝治烝烝天下仰，敬歌萬壽無疆。

translations.literal: Fifth stanza: from ten thousand regions, jade fare honors the parent's nurture; filial governance steams upward—all under Heaven look up; respectfully sing: ten thousand years without bound.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza V: from every quarter jade fare honors the parent's care; filial rule rises like steam—all the realm looks up; we sing in reverence: ten thousand years without end.

sentences.zh: 趨辭

translations.literal: Refrain for approaching.
translations.idiomatic: Approach refrain.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年，太上皇帝三大節筵宴三章進饌，中和清樂；

translations.literal: First year of the Jiaqing reign: for the Retired Emperor's three great festivals, banquet—three stanzas for presenting viands; Zhonghe Clear Music.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaqing 1: for the Retired Emperor's three great festival banquets—three movements for presenting dishes, Zhonghe Clear Music.

sentences.zh: 進茶、進酒，丹陛清樂進饌莢衍箕疇之章莢衍箕疇，春滿瀛洲，六甲慶重周。

translations.literal: Presenting tea, presenting wine: Danbi Clear Music for presenting viands—the stanza "Pods Spread the Fields of the Ladle": pods spread the fields of the ladle; spring fills Yingzhou; the six jia celebrate a renewed cycle.
translations.idiomatic: For presenting tea and wine: Danbi Clear Music, movement "Pods upon the Cosmic Chart"—pods spread across the heavenly fields; spring fills the isle of immortals; the sixfold cycle marks a renewed great year.

sentences.zh: 功德誰儔！

translations.literal: Whose merit can be matched!
translations.idiomatic: Whose merit can compare!

sentences.zh: 位祿兼名壽，並包帝道王猷。

translations.literal: Rank, emolument, fame, and longevity together; encompassing the Emperor's Way and the King's design.
translations.idiomatic: Rank, stipend, fame, and long life together; embracing the way of emperors and the designs of kings.

sentences.zh: 十全建極八徵念，五福居長百祿遒。

translations.literal: Ten perfections establish the apex; eight signs remembered; the five blessings dwell foremost; a hundred emoluments run strong.
translations.idiomatic: Ten perfections raise the summit; eight auspicious signs are held in mind; the five blessings stand foremost; a hundred fortunes flow in strength.

sentences.zh: 駕蒼周，軼赤劉，共臚萬萬添籌。

translations.literal: The carriage surpasses the Zhou of azure; excels the Han of crimson; together they tally myriads upon myriads—add tallies to the tally.
translations.idiomatic: The throne outshines the azure Zhou; surpasses the crimson Han; together we count myriads upon myriads—add tally upon tally to the count.

sentences.zh: 一解敬維作所酬高厚，圜壇冬至齋宮就。

translations.literal: First stanza: respectfully consider the work-place, repaying Heaven's height and earth's depth; the round altar at winter solstice—the fasting palace is reached.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza I: in reverence we consider the sacred task, repaying Heaven's height and earth's depth; at the round altar on winter solstice the fasting palace is reached.

sentences.zh: 方壇夏至明禋奏，祈年雩祭均循候。

translations.literal: The square altar at summer solstice—the bright sacrifice is offered; prayers for harvest and rain rites alike follow the seasons.
translations.idiomatic: At the square altar on summer solstice the bright sacrifice is offered; prayers for harvest and rain rites alike follow the seasons.

sentences.zh: 加玉表精忱，縮鬯通聲臭，珠囊氣協神祇祐。

translations.literal: Add jade to display refined sincerity; condensed aromatics convey scent and savor; pearl pouches harmonize the qi—spirits and earth-gods grant blessing.
translations.idiomatic: Jade is added to show refined devotion; condensed aromatics carry scent and savor; pearl pouches harmonize the breath—spirits and earth-gods grant their blessing.

sentences.zh: 二解遵守寶籙，朝朝誦大猷，萬乘謁珠丘，冠服貽謀，弓矢貽謀。

translations.literal: Second stanza: uphold the precious register; morning after morning recite the great design; the ten-thousand chariots visit Pearl Hill; caps and robes bequeath the plan; bows and arrows bequeath the plan.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza II: uphold the sacred register; day after day recite the great design; the imperial host visits Pearl Hill; caps and robes pass down the plan; bows and arrows pass down the plan.

sentences.zh: 盛京賦，賦鴻庥，霞繃燃處明如晝。

translations.literal: Ode to the Flourishing Capital; ode to vast blessing; where the cloud-banners burn, bright as noon.
translations.idiomatic: An ode to the Flourishing Capital; an ode to vast blessing; where the cloud-banners burn, bright as midday.

sentences.zh: 紀恩堂，堂構綢繆。

translations.literal: Hall of Recording Grace; the hall's structure is carefully planned.
translations.idiomatic: The Hall of Recording Grace; its structure is laid with care.

sentences.zh: 習騎射，御驊騮，歲歲木蘭蒐狩。

translations.literal: Practice riding and archery; mount the piebald steeds; year after year at Mulan, the imperial hunt.
translations.idiomatic: He practices riding and archery; mounts piebald steeds; year after year hunts at Mulan.

sentences.zh: 三解宵衣問夜傳清漏，瑤殿上，勤政名留。

translations.literal: Third stanza: rise at dawn, inquire through the night—the clear clepsydra sounds; upon the jade hall, the name for diligent rule remains.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza III: rising at dawn he inquires through the night as the clear water-clock sounds; upon the jade hall his name for diligent rule endures.

sentences.zh: 不待雞人報曉籌，燃絳蠟，答詞頭。

translations.literal: Without waiting for the cock-herald to announce dawn's tally; red candles are lit; memorial drafts are answered.
translations.idiomatic: Without waiting for the dawn herald's call; red candles are lit; memorial drafts are answered.

sentences.zh: 四解睿慮充周，後樂先憂，茅檐蔀屋蓋藏謀。

translations.literal: Fourth stanza: sagely thought fills all around; after joy comes first worry; thatched eaves and wattled huts—all plans are held in care.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza IV: sagely thought fills every quarter; joy for himself comes only after worry for others; thatched eaves and humble roofs—all their needs are held in his care.

sentences.zh: 不惜金鏐，蠲租賜復登仁壽，茨梁在野羅漿酒。

translations.literal: He does not spare gold and silver; remits rent and grants tax relief—ascending to benevolence and longevity; thatched beams in the fields, wine spread in abundance.
translations.idiomatic: He does not spare gold and silver; remits rent and grants tax relief—raising the people to benevolence and long life; thatched roofs in the fields, wine spread in abundance.

sentences.zh: 吉亥親耕勤早耰，雨暘驛遞馳封奏，沃壤年年報有秋。

translations.literal: On the auspicious day of the boar he personally plows, diligent with the early hoe; fair rain and sunshine—dispatches race by post with sealed memorials; fertile soil year after year reports an autumn harvest.
translations.idiomatic: On the auspicious day of the boar he plows in person, diligent with the early hoe; fair rain and sunshine—memorials race by post; fertile soil year after year reports a full harvest.

sentences.zh: 五解包羅星宿，御丹毫，文成萬首。

translations.literal: Fifth stanza: encompassing the star-hosts; wielding the cinnabar brush; compositions in prose, ten thousand pieces.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza V: encompassing the hosts of stars; wielding the vermilion brush; compositions in prose, ten thousand pieces.

sentences.zh: 味腴餐秀，有數萬餘篇摛錦繡，丹黃四庫皆經奏。

translations.literal: Rich flavor, refined repast—several tens of thousands of pieces weave brocade and embroidery; cinnabar and yellow—the Four Repositories all have passed review.
translations.idiomatic: Rich fare, refined repast—several tens of thousands of pieces weave brocade and embroidery; cinnabar and yellow—the Four Repositories all have passed imperial review.

sentences.zh: 更臨雍宣講，璧水環橋欣覯。

translations.literal: Moreover at the Hall of Enlightenment he proclaims and lectures; jade water encircles the bridge—joy to behold.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover at the Hall of Enlightenment he lectures; jade water encircles the bridge—a joy to behold.

sentences.zh: 禮成釋菜，又看典茂鴻都，石經鐫就。

translations.literal: When the rites are complete, vegetables are offered; again we see the canon flourish at Hongdu; the stone classics are carved and done.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites are complete, vegetables are offered; again we see the canon flourish at Hongdu; the stone classics are carved and finished.

sentences.zh: 六解二十矢，天弧彀，廣運南朔東西，威稜處處周。

translations.literal: Sixth stanza: twenty arrows; the celestial bow's notch; vast sway south, north, east, and west; awesomeness everywhere complete.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza VI: twenty arrows; the celestial bow's notch; vast sway south, north, east, and west; imperial might reaches every quarter.

sentences.zh: 拓疆二萬，亥步全收。

translations.literal: Territory expanded twenty thousand [li]; the twelfth earthly branch's paces—all gathered in.
translations.idiomatic: Territory expanded twenty thousand leagues; every frontier pace brought within the realm.

sentences.zh: 遐陬襁負投，歸降歸順，更兼廓喀鯤番一候。

translations.literal: From distant corners, babes on backs come to submit; surrender and allegiance; moreover Gurkha, Kunlun tribes—all within one frontier.
translations.idiomatic: From distant corners, infants on backs come to submit; surrender and allegiance; Gurkha and Kunlun tribes—all within one frontier.

sentences.zh: 七解仁壽貞符同輻輳。

translations.literal: Seventh stanza: benevolence, longevity, and true signs together like wheel-spokes converging.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza VII: benevolence, longevity, and true signs converge like spokes of a wheel.

sentences.zh: 十一世，金枝秀。

translations.literal: Eleven generations; golden branches flourish.
translations.idiomatic: Eleven generations; golden branches flourish.

sentences.zh: 聯珠合璧，月將日就。

translations.literal: Linked pearls and joined jades; the moon approaches, the sun draws near.
translations.idiomatic: Pearls linked and jades joined; moon and sun draw near in harmony.

sentences.zh: 二千里黃河清潄，仙蝶呈祥晴雪後。

translations.literal: For two thousand li the Yellow River runs clear; immortal butterflies present auspicious signs after clear snow.
translations.idiomatic: For two thousand li the Yellow River runs clear; immortal butterflies bring auspicious signs after the clear snow.

sentences.zh: 慶昌期，中天候，重逢重遘。

translations.literal: Celebrate the flourishing term; the mid-heaven's season; reunion upon reunion.
translations.idiomatic: We celebrate the flourishing age; the season at heaven's center; reunion upon blessed reunion.

sentences.zh: 八解玉燭金甌，天行一日一周。

translations.literal: Eighth stanza: jade candles and golden bowl; Heaven moves one day, one circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza VIII: jade candles and golden bowl; Heaven moves one day, one full circuit.

sentences.zh: 孜孜惟日耄期猶，自強不息符乾九。

translations.literal: Diligent, diligent—day by day even in aged fullness he still strives; unceasing self-strengthening matches Qian, the ninth.
translations.idiomatic: Diligent, diligent—day by day even in great age he still strives; unceasing self-strengthening matches the ninth hexagram Qian.

sentences.zh: 膺篤祜，璿莢珠籌，子帝承歡千萬壽。

translations.literal: He receives deep blessing; jade pods and pearl tallies; the Son-Emperor bears joy—ten thousand myriad years of life.
translations.idiomatic: He receives deep blessing; jade pods and pearl tallies; the Son-Emperor bears joy—ten thousand myriad years of life.

sentences.zh: 趨辭進茶玉燭調元之章玉燭調元，日彩旭曈曨，正聯珠合璧慶重逢。

translations.literal: Approach refrain for presenting tea—the stanza "Jade Candles Harmonize the Origin": jade candles harmonize the origin; sun's colors at dawn, bright and hazy; just now linked pearls and joined jades celebrate reunion.
translations.idiomatic: Approach refrain for presenting tea—movement "Jade Candles Harmonize the Origin": jade candles harmonize the origin; dawn's colors glow hazy and bright; linked pearls and joined jades celebrate reunion.

sentences.zh: 星輝雲爛藹和風，角亢吐三耀辰居拱。

translations.literal: Stars shine, clouds glow, gentle breezes mild; Horn and Neck spit forth three glories—the celestial seat bows in arch.
translations.idiomatic: Stars shine, clouds glow, gentle breezes blow mild; Horn and Neck send forth three glories—the celestial seat bows in arch.

sentences.zh: 春意盎，瑞光融，看萬年枝更動，萬年觴奉，添籌積算乾綱總，一家堯舜貞符共。

translations.literal: Spring intent overflows; auspicious light melts; behold the ten-thousand-year branch stir again; ten-thousand-year goblets offered; add tallies, accumulate counts—the Qian net's sum; one household, Yao and Shun, true signs together.
translations.idiomatic: Spring overflows; auspicious light melts; behold the branch of ten thousand years stir again; ten-thousand-year goblets are offered; tallies added, counts accumulated—the sum of Heaven's design; one household like Yao and Shun, true signs together.

sentences.zh: 繞陛雲煙擁，壽介衢尊，恩流寶甕。

translations.literal: Cloud and mist embrace around the steps; longevity reaches the crossroads' wine-vessel; grace flows from the precious urn.
translations.idiomatic: Cloud and mist embrace around the steps; longevity reaches the wine-vessel at the crossroads; grace flows from the precious urn.

sentences.zh: 一解主敬宸衷，後天而奉，紀元周甲蘿圖鞏。

translations.literal: First stanza: master reverence in the imperial heart; following Heaven in service; the era's count completes the jia of Zhou—the vine chart is secured.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza I: reverence rules the imperial heart; following Heaven in service; the era's count completes the jia of Zhou—the vine chart is secured.

sentences.zh: 隆授受，養尊崇，積京垓，臣民頌，萬禩慶延洪。

translations.literal: Grandly receiving abdication and transmission; nurturing with supreme honor; piling up myriads and hundreds of millions; officials and people praise; ten thousand ages celebrate extension vast.
translations.idiomatic: Grandly receiving abdication and transmission; nurturing with supreme honor; blessings pile to myriads and hundreds of millions; officials and people praise; ten thousand ages celebrate extension vast.

sentences.zh: 如日方中，麗桐軒，輝松棟。

translations.literal: Like the sun at mid-heaven; beautiful paulownia portico; pine beams shine.
translations.idiomatic: Like the sun at mid-heaven; beautiful paulownia portico; pine beams shine.

sentences.zh: 二解瓜瓞綿綿，椒衍金枝重，五福名堂萬福同。

translations.literal: Second stanza: melons and vines stretch on and on; pepper-sprigs spread, golden branches multiply; Hall of the Five Blessings, Hall of Ten Thousand Blessings alike.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza II: melons and vines stretch on and on; pepper-sprigs spread, golden branches multiply; Hall of the Five Blessings, Hall of Ten Thousand Blessings alike.

sentences.zh: 瑤牒書石眾瑞徵，麟趾慶恆鍾，繩繩繼繼，疊見祥雲擁。

translations.literal: Jade registers inscribed in stone—many auspicious signs; unicorn footprints, celebration ever struck; continuous, generation after generation; again and again auspicious clouds embrace.
translations.idiomatic: Jade registers inscribed in stone—many auspicious signs; unicorn footprints, celebration ever struck; continuous, generation after generation; again and again auspicious clouds embrace.

sentences.zh: 祝來晜，奕禩荷蒼穹。

translations.literal: Blessings for generations to come; age after age bear the azure vault.
translations.idiomatic: Blessings for generations to come; age after age they bear the azure vault.

sentences.zh: 三解武於鑠，十全同頌，文丕煥，四德俱隆，箕疇錫福福來崇。

translations.literal: Third stanza: martial brilliance shines; ten perfections praised alike; civil splendor blazes; four virtues all lofty; the ladle-fields grant blessing—blessing comes in honor.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza III: martial brilliance shines; ten perfections praised alike; civil splendor blazes; four virtues all lofty; the cosmic chart grants blessing—blessing comes in honor.

sentences.zh: 皇極慶，道泰時雍。

translations.literal: The imperial apex celebrates; the Way is great, the age harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial apex celebrates; the Way is great, the age harmonious.

sentences.zh: 四解恩榜制科，先中慶遭逢，杏花春雨桂秋風。

translations.literal: Fourth stanza: grace rolls and civil examinations; first to pass—joy at the encounter; apricot blossoms, spring rain; cassia, autumn wind.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza IV: grace rolls and civil examinations; first to pass—joy at the encounter; apricot blossoms, spring rain; cassia, autumn wind.

sentences.zh: 澤龐洪，年逾耆耋觀光踴，遠超五老首曹松。

translations.literal: Favor vast and great; years past old age, viewing the radiance with joy; far surpassing the Five Elders—foremost is Cao Song.
translations.idiomatic: Favor vast and great; past old age, viewing the radiance with joy; far surpassing the Five Elders—foremost is Cao Song.

sentences.zh: 首曹松，七旬以外成均貢。

translations.literal: Foremost Cao Song; beyond seventy, tribute from the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Foremost Cao Song; beyond seventy, tribute from the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 五解會耆英，三千眾，奏鈞天廣樂同雲夢。

translations.literal: Fifth stanza: assembly of venerable worthies; three thousand in the host; perform the vast music of Juntian, like the Cloud Dream.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza V: assembly of venerable worthies; three thousand in the host; perform the vast music of Juntian, like the Cloud Dream.

sentences.zh: 甘膏渥，湛露濃，十年方舉燕方瞳，鳩飾許攜筇。

translations.literal: Sweet moisture rich; deep dew thick; only after ten years is the banquet held—square pupils; dove adornment permits carrying the staff.
translations.idiomatic: Sweet moisture rich; deep dew thick; only after ten years is the banquet held—square pupils; dove adornment permits carrying the staff.

sentences.zh: 六解藏富三農，八蠲常貢，偏隅薄歉停輸供。

translations.literal: Sixth stanza: store wealth among the three farmers; eight remissions of regular tribute; remote corners with thin harvests halt grain delivery.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza VI: store wealth among the three farmers; eight remissions of regular tribute; remote corners with thin harvests halt grain delivery.

sentences.zh: 問暘雨，罷租庸，樂京坻，勤耕種，鼓腹共融融。

translations.literal: Inquire about fair sun and rain; abolish rent and corvée; rejoice at the capital's mound; diligent plowing and sowing; bellies full, all warm together.
translations.idiomatic: Inquire about fair sun and rain; abolish rent and corvée; rejoice at the capital's mound; diligent plowing and sowing; bellies full, all warm together.

sentences.zh: 寰宇綏豐，舞康衢，賡豳頌。

translations.literal: All within the seas pacified and abundant; dance on the peaceful thoroughfare; continue the Bin odes in praise.
translations.idiomatic: All within the seas pacified and abundant; dance on the peaceful thoroughfare; continue the Bin odes in praise.

sentences.zh: 七解就日瞻雲九宇同，占風協律集球共，岳修川效朝正眾。

translations.literal: Seventh stanza: approach the sun, gaze at clouds—nine realms alike; observe winds, harmonize pitch-pipes, gather tribute spheres together; mountains repaired, rivers effective—all court the New Year in assembly.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza VII: approach the sun, gaze at clouds—nine realms alike; observe winds, harmonize pitch-pipes, gather tribute spheres together; mountains repaired, rivers effective—all court the New Year in assembly.

sentences.zh: 拓輿圖，河玉山蔥，里逾二萬入堯封。

translations.literal: Expand the cartographic chart; rivers jade-green, mountains lush; leagues exceed twenty thousand—enter Yao's domain.
translations.idiomatic: Expand the cartographic chart; rivers jade-green, mountains lush; leagues exceed twenty thousand—enter Yao's domain.

sentences.zh: 奉車書，玉帛重重。

translations.literal: Present chariots and writings; jade and silk in layers upon layers.
translations.idiomatic: Present chariots and writings; jade and silk in layers upon layers.

sentences.zh: 八解昌辰嘉會隆儀重，聽雅樂九成鳴鳳。

translations.literal: Eighth stanza: flourishing season, splendid assembly—grand rites weighty; hear elegant music, nine movements—the phoenix calls.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza VIII: flourishing season, splendid assembly—grand rites weighty; hear elegant music, nine movements—the phoenix calls.

sentences.zh: 八極盡承風，九瀛齊獻頌。

translations.literal: The eight extremities all receive the transforming wind; nine seas together offer praise.
translations.idiomatic: The eight extremities all receive the transforming wind; nine seas together offer praise.

sentences.zh: 趨辭進酒日麗瓊霄之章日麗瓊霄，春風先盎蓬萊島。

translations.literal: Approach refrain for presenting wine—the stanza "Sun Bright upon the Jade Sky": sun bright upon the jade sky; spring breeze first overflows Penglai Isle.
translations.idiomatic: Approach refrain for presenting wine—movement "Sun Bright upon the Jade Sky": sun bright upon the jade sky; spring breeze first overflows Penglai Isle.

sentences.zh: 樂奏蕭韶，天賜徵難老。

translations.literal: Music plays Xiao-Shao; Heaven bestows the sign—hard to grow old.
translations.idiomatic: Music plays Xiao-Shao; Heaven bestows the sign—hard to grow old.

sentences.zh: 一解祗承皇道，歡心萬國會三朝。

translations.literal: First stanza: respectfully uphold the imperial Way; joyous hearts from ten thousand states meet in three courts.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza I: respectfully uphold the imperial Way; joyous hearts from ten thousand states meet in three courts.

sentences.zh: 正籌添玉莢，更斗轉珠杓。

translations.literal: Just now tallies add jade pods; moreover the Dipper turns, pearl ladle shifts.
translations.idiomatic: Just now tallies add jade pods; moreover the Dipper turns, pearl ladle shifts.

sentences.zh: 糺縵縵，兗衣依黼座；

translations.literal: Coiled and winding, winding on; the ceremonial robe rests by the embroidered throne.
translations.idiomatic: Coiled and winding, winding on; the ceremonial robe rests by the embroidered throne.

sentences.zh: 爛輝輝，瑤斝奉瓊膏。

translations.literal: Blazing, brilliant; jade goblets present jade nectar.
translations.idiomatic: Blazing, brilliant; jade goblets present jade nectar.

sentences.zh: 慶昌辰，重光重潤；

translations.literal: Celebrate the flourishing season; double light, double moisture.
translations.idiomatic: Celebrate the flourishing season; double light, double moisture.

sentences.zh: 仰景運，稽舜稽堯。

translations.literal: Look up to the splendid fortune; examine Shun, examine Yao.
translations.idiomatic: Look up to the splendid fortune; examine Shun, examine Yao.

sentences.zh: 養隆山海，美軼祁姚。

translations.literal: Nurture lofty as mountains and seas; beauty surpasses Qi and Yao.
translations.idiomatic: Nurture lofty as mountains and seas; beauty surpasses Qi and Yao.

sentences.zh: 二解奕葉臚歡衍慶饒，詠振振，瑞牒標。

translations.literal: Second stanza: generation after generation, joy displayed, blessings spread rich; chant "thriving, thriving"; auspicious registers marked.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza II: generation after generation, joy displayed, blessings spread rich; chant "thriving, thriving"; auspicious registers marked.

sentences.zh: 瑤林琪樹萬尋高。

translations.literal: Jade groves, precious trees—ten thousand fathoms high.
translations.idiomatic: Jade groves, precious trees—ten thousand fathoms high.

sentences.zh: 蘭芽馥郁彤墀繞，幔亭仙樂元音妙。

translations.literal: Orchid shoots fragrant and rich around the red steps; canopy pavilion immortal music—the primal tone exquisite.
translations.idiomatic: Orchid shoots fragrant and rich around the red steps; canopy pavilion immortal music—the primal tone exquisite.

sentences.zh: 祥光絢鳳條，祥飆暖鳳巢，集雲礽獻壽和風劭。

translations.literal: Auspicious light brilliant on the phoenix branch; auspicious breeze warm at the phoenix nest; gathered cloud descendants offer longevity—harmonious winds strong.
translations.idiomatic: Auspicious light brilliant on the phoenix branch; auspicious breeze warm at the phoenix nest; gathered cloud descendants offer longevity—harmonious winds strong.

sentences.zh: 欣舞采，燦螭坳。

translations.literal: Joyful dancing with colored streamers; brilliant on the horned-dragon slope.
translations.idiomatic: Joyful dancing with colored streamers; brilliant on the horned-dragon slope.

sentences.zh: 三解列清班，鵷鸞翮高。

translations.literal: Third stanza: arrayed in the clear ranks; yuan and luan wings lofty.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza III: arrayed in the clear ranks; yuan and luan wings lofty.

sentences.zh: 鹽梅一氣調，看肅肅衣冠拜絳旓。

translations.literal: Salt and plum in one breath harmonized; behold solemn, solemn caps and robes bowing to the crimson banner.
translations.idiomatic: Salt and plum in one breath harmonized; behold solemn caps and robes bowing to the crimson banner.

sentences.zh: 北闕開，催曉箭，西山爽，靜鳴梢。

translations.literal: The northern gate opens; dawn arrows are urged; western hills fresh and clear; quietly the branches sound.
translations.idiomatic: The northern gate opens; dawn arrows are urged; western hills fresh and clear; quietly the branches sound.

sentences.zh: 斟沆瀣，酌葡萄。

translations.literal: Pour the celestial dew; sip the grape wine.
translations.idiomatic: Pour the celestial dew; sip the grape wine.

sentences.zh: 四解欣邇英，日轉槐龍清影搖。

translations.literal: Fourth stanza: joy at the Hall of Near Excellence; the sun turns, locust dragon—clear shadows sway.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza IV: joy at the Hall of Near Excellence; the sun turns, locust dragon—clear shadows sway.

sentences.zh: 更集賢，風緩梅花雜絮飄。

translations.literal: Moreover at the Hall of Gathered Worthies; wind gentle, plum blossoms and mixed flurries drift.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover at the Hall of Gathered Worthies; wind gentle, plum blossoms and mixed flurries drift.

sentences.zh: 喜華纓共彯，爐煙暖未消。

translations.literal: Joy: splendid tassels together sway; censer smoke warm, not yet dissipated.
translations.idiomatic: With joy splendid tassels sway together; warm censer smoke has not yet faded.

sentences.zh: 鳳池頭，仙翰染；

translations.literal: At the phoenix pool head, immortal brushwork is dyed;
translations.idiomatic: At the phoenix pool head, immortal brushwork is dyed;

sentences.zh: 鸞掖外，珮聲敲。

translations.literal: Outside the luan side-chamber, jade pendants sound with a tap.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the luan side-chamber, jade pendants chime with a tap.

sentences.zh: 齊祝頌，聖壽天高。

translations.literal: Together offer blessings; sagely longevity, heaven-high.
translations.idiomatic: Together we offer blessings; sagely longevity, high as heaven.

sentences.zh: 五解更皤皤黃髮飄，玉杖初扶，來聽雲璈。

translations.literal: Fifth stanza: moreover hoary-haired elders drift; jade staffs first supported—they come to hear the cloud-gongs.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza V: moreover hoary-haired elders drift; jade staffs first supported—they come to hear the cloud-gongs.

sentences.zh: 祝萬八昌期鎬燕，列三千吉語衢謠。

translations.literal: Bless ten thousand eight—the flourishing term, the grand feast; array three thousand auspicious phrases, thoroughfare songs.
translations.idiomatic: Bless the ten-thousand-and-eight flourishing age, the grand feast; array three thousand auspicious phrases, thoroughfare songs.

sentences.zh: 六解皇州暖，淑氣調，千門萬戶歡聲早。

translations.literal: Sixth stanza: the imperial capital warm; gentle qi harmonized; thousand gates, ten thousand households—joyful voices early.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza VI: the imperial capital warm; gentle breath harmonized; thousand gates, ten thousand households—joyful voices rise early.

sentences.zh: 九衢初旭笸光繞，東華紅輭雲煙裊。

translations.literal: Nine thoroughfares at first dawn—basket-light wraps around; Donghua red, soft, cloud and mist curl.
translations.idiomatic: Nine thoroughfares at first dawn—basket-light wraps around; Donghua red, soft, cloud and mist curl.

sentences.zh: 黃圖紫陌總臚歡，萬年枝上鳴春鳥。

translations.literal: Yellow chart, purple thoroughfare—all display joy; on the ten-thousand-year branch spring birds call.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow chart, purple thoroughfare—all display joy; on the ten-thousand-year branch spring birds call.

sentences.zh: 七解聯三殿，達四郊。

translations.literal: Seventh stanza: linked three halls; reaching four suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza VII: linked three halls; reaching four suburbs.

sentences.zh: 綿區匝宇茅檐表，綺塍綉罫農功早，提壺布穀春聲好。

translations.literal: The vast realm wraps the cosmos—beyond thatched eaves; embroidered fields, brocade furrows—farm work early; jug in hand, grain spread—the spring voice is good.
translations.idiomatic: The vast realm wraps the cosmos—beyond thatched eaves; embroidered fields, brocade furrows—farm work early; jug in hand, grain spread—the spring voice is good.

sentences.zh: 兕觥共原獻公堂，衢尊衢室歌鴻造。

translations.literal: Rhino goblets together at the original offering, public hall; thoroughfare wine-vessel, thoroughfare hall—sing the great creation.
translations.idiomatic: Rhino goblets together at the original offering, public hall; thoroughfare wine-vessel, thoroughfare hall—sing the great creation.

sentences.zh: 八解威稜震，德化遙。

translations.literal: Eighth stanza: awesomeness shakes; virtue transforms from afar.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza VIII: awesomeness shakes; virtue transforms from afar.

sentences.zh: 王會冠裳，海角山椒，長股僬僥。

translations.literal: Royal assembly, caps and robes; sea corner, mountain pepper; long-legged Jiaojiao.
translations.idiomatic: Royal assembly, caps and robes; sea corner, mountain pepper; long-legged Jiaojiao.

sentences.zh: 瑤階上，干羽功昭。

translations.literal: Upon the jade steps, shield and feather merit shines bright.
translations.idiomatic: Upon the jade steps, shield and feather merit shines bright.

sentences.zh: 趨閶闔，拜舞兼歡蹈。

translations.literal: Approach Changhe Gate; bowing dance together with joyful tread.
translations.idiomatic: Approach Changhe Gate; bowing dance together with joyful tread.

sentences.zh: 匝爻閭，赤帟飄颻。

translations.literal: All around the hamlets; crimson banners drift and sway.
translations.idiomatic: All around the hamlets; crimson banners drift and sway.

sentences.zh: 紈牛露犬輸奇寶，兜離僸昧，盡入咸韶。

translations.literal: White silk, oxen, dew, dogs—offer wondrous treasures; foreign tongues and distant speech—all enter Xian-Shao.
translations.idiomatic: White silk, oxen, dew, dogs—offer wondrous treasures; foreign tongues and distant speech—all enter Xian-Shao.

sentences.zh: 九解玉河縹緲，星海迢遙。

translations.literal: Ninth stanza: jade river misty and far; star sea distant and remote.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza IX: jade river misty and far; star sea distant and remote.

sentences.zh: 占城馴擾，拈國招邀，南掌山高，荷蘭颿飄，卻值元正齊到。

translations.literal: Champa tamed and pacified; Nian invited; Nanzhang mountains high; Dutch sails drift—just as New Year all arrive together.
translations.idiomatic: Champa tamed and pacified; Nian invited; Nanzhang mountains high; Dutch sails drift—just as New Year all arrive together.

sentences.zh: 慶中天，仰碧霄，路繞銅標，韻葉鸞鑣。

translations.literal: Celebrate mid-heaven; look up to the azure sky; roads wind around bronze markers; rhyme-leaves, luan bridle-bits.
translations.idiomatic: Celebrate mid-heaven; look up to the azure sky; roads wind around bronze markers; rhyme-leaves, luan bridle-bits.

sentences.zh: 占青雲，疊來重譯；

translations.literal: Occupy azure clouds; layers of repeated translation;
translations.idiomatic: Occupy azure clouds; layers of repeated translation;

sentences.zh: 趨黃道，共上輕軺。

translations.literal: Approach the Yellow Way; together mount the light carriage.
translations.idiomatic: Approach the Yellow Way; together mount the light carriage.

sentences.zh: 會嘉慶，舞雲翹，南詣北燮祥輝耀。

translations.literal: Meet the splendid celebration; dance cloud banners; south and north in harmony—auspicious radiance shines.
translations.idiomatic: Meet the splendid celebration; dance cloud banners; south and north in harmony—auspicious radiance shines.

sentences.zh: 鳧趨魚藻，式燕翔翱。

translations.literal: Duck-hurry, fish-algae; banquet style, soaring flight.
translations.idiomatic: Duck-hurry, fish-algae; banquet style, soaring flight.

sentences.zh: 十解軼黃農，超羲昊，進長生，水玉膏，金鑒常懸帝范高。

translations.literal: Tenth stanza: surpass the Yellow Farmer; exceed Xi and Hao; present long life; water-jade paste; golden mirror ever hung—the imperial model high.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza X: surpass the Yellow Farmer; exceed Xi and Hao; present long life; water-jade paste; golden mirror ever hung—the imperial model high.

sentences.zh: 群欽帝德嶢嶢，煥珠弧，上瑞先昭。

translations.literal: All revere imperial virtue lofty and high; brilliant pearl arc; upper auspice first declared.
translations.idiomatic: All revere imperial virtue lofty and high; brilliant pearl arc; upper auspice first declared.

sentences.zh: 泰策乾符，上下交頌，兼容並包。

translations.literal: Grand policy, Qian symbol; above and below together praise; inclusive and encompassing.
translations.idiomatic: Grand policy, Qian symbol; above and below together praise; inclusive and encompassing.

sentences.zh: 積京垓億兆，霞觴重酌種蟠桃。

translations.literal: Pile up myriads and hundreds of millions; rosy goblets pour again—plant the flat peach.
translations.idiomatic: Pile up myriads and hundreds of millions; rosy goblets pour again—plant the flat peach.

sentences.zh: 趨辭

translations.literal: Refrain for approaching.
translations.idiomatic: Approach refrain.

sentences.zh: 皇帝三大節、上元、除夕筵宴三章進茶、進酒丹陛清樂，進饌中和清樂進茶海宇昇平日之章海宇昇平日，景物雍熙，偏乾坤，草木樂清時。

translations.literal: The Emperor's three great festivals, Lantern Festival, New Year's Eve—banquet, three stanzas for presenting tea and wine: Danbi Clear Music; presenting viands, Zhonghe Clear Music for presenting tea—the stanza "Days When Sea and Realm Rise": days when sea and realm rise; scenery harmonious and bright; throughout heaven and earth; grass and trees rejoice in the clear age.
translations.idiomatic: For the Emperor's three great festivals, Lantern Festival, and New Year's Eve—banquet, three movements for presenting tea and wine: Danbi Clear Music; for presenting dishes, Zhonghe Clear Music for tea—movement "Days When Sea and Realm Rise": days when sea and realm rise; scenery harmonious and bright; throughout heaven and earth; grass and trees rejoice in the clear age.

sentences.zh: 河清海晏麥雙歧，麟游鳳集枝連理。

translations.literal: The Yellow River runs clear, the sea is calm; wheat bears double ears; unicorns roam, phoenixes gather—branches join in pairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow River runs clear, the sea is calm; wheat bears double ears; unicorns roam, phoenixes gather—branches join in pairs.

sentences.zh: 風澹澹，日依依。

translations.literal: Wind gentle, gentle; sun lingering, lingering.
translations.idiomatic: Wind blows gentle and mild; the sun lingers soft and long.

sentences.zh: 正蓬壺乍啟，天顏有喜。

translations.literal: Just now Penglai first opens; the imperial countenance shows joy.
translations.idiomatic: Just now Penglai first opens; the Son of Heaven's face shows joy.

sentences.zh: 金門嶰竹傳仙吹，金猊篆裊香煙細，合殿歡聲殷地。

translations.literal: Golden Gate, xie bamboo transmits immortal breath; golden censer seal-script curls, incense smoke fine; the whole hall's joyful voices shake the ground.
translations.idiomatic: Golden Gate, xie bamboo transmits immortal breath; golden censer seal-script curls, incense smoke fine; the whole hall's joyful voices shake the ground.

sentences.zh: 一統山河，萬年天子。

translations.literal: One realm, mountains and rivers; ten-thousand-year Son of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: One realm, mountains and rivers; the Son of Heaven for ten thousand years.

sentences.zh: 一解佳氣佳瑞滿皇畿，天門詄盪御筵披，千峰疊嶂排晴翠。

translations.literal: First stanza: fine qi, fine omens fill the imperial precinct; heavenly gate hymns surge—the imperial banquet spreads; thousand peaks, layered ranges, array clear emerald.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza I: fine breath, fine omens fill the imperial precinct; heavenly gate hymns surge—the imperial banquet spreads; thousand peaks, layered ranges, array clear emerald.

sentences.zh: 動龍蛇，日暖旌旗，青蔥玉樹萬年枝。

translations.literal: Stirring like dragon and serpent; sun warm, banners and flags; verdant jade trees on the ten-thousand-year branch.
translations.idiomatic: Stirring like dragon and serpent; sun warm, banners and flags; verdant jade trees on the ten-thousand-year branch.

sentences.zh: 燕溫溫，玉戺金墀。

translations.literal: Swallow warmth, warmth; jade threshold, golden steps.
translations.idiomatic: Swallow warmth, warmth; jade threshold, golden steps.

sentences.zh: 二解天工四序平分歲，皇心惟念小民依。

translations.literal: Second stanza: heaven's craft, four seasons evenly divide the year; the imperial heart only thinks of the common people relying on it.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza II: heaven's craft, four seasons evenly divide the year; the imperial heart only thinks of the common people relying on it.

sentences.zh: 一自農功始、祁寒暑雨遍疇咨。

translations.literal: From the time farm work begins—cold, heat, rain, and drought throughout the fields are consulted.
translations.idiomatic: From the time farm work begins—cold, heat, rain, and drought throughout the fields are consulted.

sentences.zh: 崇墉櫛比，豐樂成民瑞；

translations.literal: Lofty walls row upon row; abundance and joy become the people's auspice;
translations.idiomatic: Lofty walls row upon row; abundance and joy become the people's auspice;

sentences.zh: 真民瑞，茅檐外，蕭鼓樂豳詩。

translations.literal: Truly the people's auspice; beyond thatched eaves, reed drums and music rejoice in the Bin odes.
translations.idiomatic: Truly the people's auspice; beyond thatched eaves, reed drums and music rejoice in the Bin odes.

sentences.zh: 三解溯當年，深仁厚澤；

translations.literal: Third stanza: trace back to those years—deep benevolence, thick grace;
translations.idiomatic: Stanza III: trace back to those years—deep benevolence, thick grace;

sentences.zh: 到於今，累洽重熙。

translations.literal: Down to today—accumulated harmony, repeated splendor.
translations.idiomatic: Down to today—accumulated harmony, repeated splendor.

sentences.zh: 皇心繼述踵前徽，勤宵旰，敕惟時惟幾。

translations.literal: The imperial heart continues and follows the former emblem; diligent at dawn and dusk; edicts—only at the proper time, only in due measure.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial heart continues and follows the former emblem; diligent at dawn and dusk; edicts—only at the proper time, only in due measure.

sentences.zh: 四解孝饗吉蠲，修祀事，奉明粢。

translations.literal: Fourth stanza: filial offerings auspicious and pure; repair sacrificial affairs; present bright grain.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza IV: filial offerings auspicious and pure; repair sacrificial affairs; present bright grain.

sentences.zh: 於豆於登祝繁禧，為民祈聖心無逸。

translations.literal: In the vessels, on the stands—bless abundant fortune; for the people pray—the sagely heart without rest.
translations.idiomatic: In the vessels, on the stands—bless abundant fortune; for the people pray—the sagely heart without rest.

sentences.zh: 天庥至，天心錫福聖無為。

translations.literal: Heaven's favor arrives; heaven's heart bestows blessing—the sage without exertion.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's favor arrives; heaven's heart bestows blessing—the sage without exertion.

sentences.zh: 聖無為，太平恭己垂裳治。

translations.literal: The sage without exertion; Great Peace—respectfully he himself drapes the robe and governs.
translations.idiomatic: The sage without exertion; Great Peace—respectfully he himself drapes the robe and governs.

sentences.zh: 五解得賢臣，襄上理，賁干旌，連茹匯征至。

translations.literal: Fifth stanza: obtain worthy ministers; assist in governing above; adorn the dry banner; linked reeds, converging summons arrive.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza V: obtain worthy ministers; assist in governing above; adorn the dry banner; linked reeds, converging summons arrive.

sentences.zh: 蟬有緌，鷺在墀。

translations.literal: Cicadas with tassels; egrets on the courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: Cicadas with tassels; egrets on the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 九苞颺彩映朝曦，來集上林枝。

translations.literal: Nine-fold splendor reflects the morning sun; they come to gather on the upper forest branch.
translations.idiomatic: Nine-fold splendor reflects the morning sun; they come to gather on the upper forest branch.

sentences.zh: 六解民俗恬熙，盈寧婦子，康衢黃髮偕兒齒。

translations.literal: Sixth stanza: folk customs calm and bright; fullness and peace for wives and children; peaceful thoroughfare, yellow hair together with children's teeth.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza VI: folk customs calm and bright; fullness and peace for wives and children; peaceful thoroughfare, yellow hair together with children's teeth.

sentences.zh: 食舊德，服新菑。

translations.literal: Eat old virtue; wear new blessings.
translations.idiomatic: Eat old virtue; wear new blessings.

sentences.zh: 想中天，堯舜世，鼓腹共游嬉，亦越於茲。

translations.literal: Think of mid-heaven—the age of Yao and Shun; bellies full, together roam and play; also surpassing this time.
translations.idiomatic: Think of mid-heaven—the age of Yao and Shun; bellies full, together roam and play; also surpassing this time.

sentences.zh: 戴堯天，遵舜軌。

translations.literal: Wear Yao's heaven; follow Shun's track.
translations.idiomatic: Wear Yao's heaven; follow Shun's track.

sentences.zh: 七解重譯來時，梯航萬里，冠裳玉帛圖王會。

translations.literal: Seventh stanza: repeated translation comes; ladders and ships ten thousand li; caps, robes, jade and silk—the chart of royal assembly.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza VII: repeated translation comes; ladders and ships ten thousand li; caps, robes, jade and silk—the chart of royal assembly.

sentences.zh: 於萬載，太平基。

translations.literal: For ten thousand generations—the foundation of Great Peace.
translations.idiomatic: For ten thousand generations—the foundation of Great Peace.

sentences.zh: 想中天，堯舜世，鼓腹共游嬉，亦越於茲。

translations.literal: Think of mid-heaven—the age of Yao and Shun; bellies full, together roam and play; also surpassing this time.
translations.idiomatic: Think of mid-heaven—the age of Yao and Shun; bellies full, together roam and play; also surpassing this time.

sentences.zh: 戴堯天，遵舜軌。

translations.literal: Wear Yao's heaven; follow Shun's track.
translations.idiomatic: Wear Yao's heaven; follow Shun's track.

sentences.zh: 八解皇心和豫陽春似，自萬類，光輝盛美。

translations.literal: Eighth stanza: the imperial heart harmonious and pleased—spring days alike; from ten thousand kinds, radiance and splendor flourish.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza VIII: the imperial heart harmonious and pleased—spring days alike; from ten thousand kinds, radiance and splendor flourish.

sentences.zh: 四海共傾葵，五雲齊獻瑞。

translations.literal: Within the four seas together incline like sunflowers; five clouds together present auspicious signs.
translations.idiomatic: Within the four seas together incline like sunflowers; five clouds together present auspicious signs.

sentences.zh: 趨辭

translations.literal: Refrain for approaching.
translations.idiomatic: Approach refrain.

sentences.zh: 進酒玉殿雲開之章玉殿雲開，金門春在蓬壺界。

translations.literal: Presenting wine—the stanza "Jade Hall, Clouds Open": jade hall, clouds open; golden gate, spring dwells in the Penglai realm.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting wine—movement "Jade Hall, Clouds Open": jade hall, clouds open; golden gate, spring dwells in the Penglai realm.

sentences.zh: 日月昭回，景福齊天大。

translations.literal: Sun and moon shine and return; splendid fortune together with heaven is great.
translations.idiomatic: Sun and moon shine and return; splendid fortune together with heaven is great.

sentences.zh: 一解乾坤清泰，五雲深處是三台。

translations.literal: First stanza: heaven and earth clear and peaceful; five clouds deep within—that is the Three Terraces.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza I: heaven and earth clear and peaceful; five clouds deep within—that is the Three Terraces.

sentences.zh: 看句陳北指，更閣道南回。

translations.literal: Behold Gouchen pointing north; moreover the covered way turns south again.
translations.idiomatic: Behold Gouchen pointing north; moreover the covered way turns south again.

sentences.zh: 明朗朗，左樞兼上相；

translations.literal: Bright, bright; left pivot together with chief minister;
translations.idiomatic: Bright, bright; left pivot together with chief minister;

sentences.zh: 爛熒熒，龍角枕河魁。

translations.literal: Blazing, gleaming; dragon horn rests on the River Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Blazing, gleaming; dragon horn rests on the River Chief.

sentences.zh: 際中天，珠聯璧合；

translations.literal: At mid-heaven; pearls linked, jades joined;
translations.idiomatic: At mid-heaven; pearls linked, jades joined;

sentences.zh: 仰紫極，麕至鳧來。

translations.literal: Look up to the purple apex; elk arrive, ducks come.
translations.idiomatic: Look up to the purple apex; elk arrive, ducks come.

sentences.zh: 一人有慶，萬國春台。

translations.literal: One man has celebration; ten thousand states, spring terrace.
translations.idiomatic: One man has celebration; ten thousand states, spring terrace.

sentences.zh: 二解府事修和籥俊才，扇仁風，遍九垓，萬方樂育仰栽培。

translations.literal: Second stanza: government affairs cultivated in harmony, tally-talented men; fan benevolent winds throughout the nine regions; ten thousand directions joyful nurture, look up to cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza II: government affairs cultivated in harmony, tally-talented men; fan benevolent winds throughout the nine regions; ten thousand directions joyful nurture, look up to cultivation.

sentences.zh: 一人宵旰符真宰，幾康劼毖天工代。

translations.literal: One man at dawn and dusk matches the true steward; several healthy, vigorous efforts—heaven's craft on his behalf.
translations.idiomatic: One man at dawn and dusk matches the true steward; several healthy, vigorous efforts—heaven's craft on his behalf.

sentences.zh: 民生亦快哉，饔飧廑聖懷。

translations.literal: The people's livelihood is also joyful; morning and evening meals—the sagely heart is concerned.
translations.idiomatic: The people's livelihood is also joyful; morning and evening meals—the sagely heart is concerned.

sentences.zh: 勵憂勤，保大持盈泰。

translations.literal: Encourage worry and diligence; preserve the great, hold fullness—peace.
translations.idiomatic: Encourage worry and diligence; preserve the great, hold fullness—peace.

sentences.zh: 歌帝力，望堯階。

translations.literal: Sing the Emperor's strength; gaze at Yao's steps.
translations.idiomatic: Sing the Emperor's strength; gaze at Yao's steps.

sentences.zh: 三解香馥馥，葡萄潑醅，天漿泛玉杯，光灧灧，露從仙掌開。

translations.literal: Third stanza: fragrance rich, rich; grape wine poured in the mash; celestial nectar fills jade cups; light shimmering, shimmering; dew from the immortal palm opens.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza III: fragrance rich, rich; grape wine poured in the mash; celestial nectar fills jade cups; light shimmering, shimmering; dew from the immortal palm opens.

sentences.zh: 北斗傾，萬壽觴；

translations.literal: The Northern Dipper tilts; ten-thousand-years goblet;
translations.idiomatic: The Northern Dipper tilts; ten-thousand-years goblet;

sentences.zh: 南山獻，延壽杯。

translations.literal: The southern mountain offers; longevity cup.
translations.idiomatic: The southern mountain offers; longevity cup.

sentences.zh: 慶玉食，萬方來。

translations.literal: Celebrate jade fare; ten thousand regions come.
translations.idiomatic: Celebrate jade fare; ten thousand regions come.

sentences.zh: 四解看蓬瀛春暖，林巒間早梅。

translations.literal: Fourth stanza: behold Penglai spring warmth; among forest peaks early plum.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza IV: behold Penglai spring warmth; among forest peaks early plum.

sentences.zh: 喜風和日麗，年華入睿裁。

translations.literal: Joy: wind harmonious, sun beautiful; the year's splendor enters the sagely judgment.
translations.idiomatic: Joy: wind harmonious, sun beautiful; the year's splendor enters the sagely judgment.

sentences.zh: 況山巔水隈，玲瓏萬卉開。

translations.literal: Moreover mountain peak, water bend—exquisite, ten thousand blooms open.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover mountain peak, water bend—exquisite, ten thousand blooms open.

sentences.zh: 綠芊芊，蘚似茵，紅灼灼，花如海。

translations.literal: Green, lush; moss like a mat; red, blazing; flowers like a sea.
translations.idiomatic: Green, lush; moss like a mat; red, blazing; flowers like a sea.

sentences.zh: 雨過也，隱隱輕雷。

translations.literal: After rain passes; faintly, faintly, light thunder.
translations.idiomatic: After rain passes; faintly, faintly, light thunder.

sentences.zh: 五解到清和，暑風來。

translations.literal: Fifth stanza: reaching clear harmony; summer winds come.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza V: reaching clear harmony; summer winds come.

sentences.zh: 茂對乘時，長景恢台。

translations.literal: Abundant response, riding the season; long days, grand terrace.
translations.idiomatic: Abundant response, riding the season; long days, grand terrace.

sentences.zh: 敞水殿，紅紛綠駭；

translations.literal: Open the water hall; red scattered, green startled;
translations.idiomatic: Open the water hall; red scattered, green startled;

sentences.zh: 曳暄颸，楊柳毰毸。

translations.literal: Draw warm breezes; willows flutter and sway.
translations.idiomatic: Draw warm breezes; willows flutter and sway.

sentences.zh: 六解金飆至，商序回，清秋皓月揚光彩。

translations.literal: Sixth stanza: golden winds arrive; the merchant sequence returns; clear autumn, bright moon raises light and color.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza VI: golden winds arrive; the merchant sequence returns; clear autumn, bright moon raises light and color.

sentences.zh: 芙蓉初日舒蓓蕾。

translations.literal: Lotus at first sun unfolds bud and bloom.
translations.idiomatic: Lotus at first sun unfolds bud and bloom.

sentences.zh: 平疇稏黃雲藹，歲登大有萬民歡，皇仁優渥敷天戴。

translations.literal: Level fields, ripe grain, yellow clouds misty; year ascends great abundance—ten thousand people rejoice; imperial benevolence rich and thick spreads heaven's canopy.
translations.idiomatic: Level fields, ripe grain, yellow clouds misty; year ascends great abundance—ten thousand people rejoice; imperial benevolence rich and thick spreads heaven's canopy.

sentences.zh: 七解寒雲沍，四序垓，一陽來復天心泰。

translations.literal: Seventh stanza: cold clouds frozen; four seasons' cycle; one yang returns—heaven's heart is peaceful.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza VII: cold clouds frozen; four seasons' cycle; one yang returns—heaven's heart is peaceful.

sentences.zh: 兕觥釃酒公堂介，豐年蠟饗吹豳賽。

translations.literal: Rhino goblets pour wine at the public hall; abundant year, wax offering—blow the Bin, compete.
translations.idiomatic: Rhino goblets pour wine at the public hall; abundant year, wax offering—blow the Bin, compete.

sentences.zh: 乾資美利本無言，帝恩廣運真無外。

translations.literal: Qian provides beautiful benefit—originally without words; imperial grace broadly moves—truly without outside.
translations.idiomatic: Qian provides beautiful benefit—originally without words; imperial grace broadly moves—truly without outside.

sentences.zh: 八解天呈瑞，愜睿懷。

translations.literal: Eighth stanza: heaven presents auspicious signs; satisfies the sagely heart.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza VIII: heaven presents auspicious signs; satisfies the sagely heart.

sentences.zh: 金鏡光輝，玉燭和諧。

translations.literal: Golden mirror radiance; jade candles harmonious.
translations.idiomatic: Golden mirror radiance; jade candles harmonious.

sentences.zh: 鳴鳳雝喈，堯棟上，雲影徘徊；

translations.literal: The phoenix calls harmonious; upon Yao's beam; cloud shadows linger and roam;
translations.idiomatic: The phoenix calls harmonious; upon Yao's beam; cloud shadows linger and roam;

sentences.zh: 舜琴中，慍為吾民解。

translations.literal: Within Shun's zither; anger he releases for our people.
translations.idiomatic: Within Shun's zither; anger he releases for our people.

sentences.zh: 奏南薰，還阜民財。

translations.literal: Play the southern breeze; return abundance to the people's wealth.
translations.idiomatic: Play the southern breeze; return abundance to the people's wealth.

sentences.zh: 冠裳玉帛圖王會，皇風蕩蕩，聖德巍巍。

translations.literal: Caps, robes, jade and silk—the chart of royal assembly; imperial winds vast and wide; sagely virtue lofty and grand.
translations.idiomatic: Caps, robes, jade and silk—the chart of royal assembly; imperial winds vast and wide; sagely virtue lofty and grand.

sentences.zh: 九解淵思往代，茅茨土階，不圖不繪。

translations.literal: Ninth stanza: deep thought on former ages; thatched huts, earthen steps; no pictures, no paintings.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza IX: deep thought on former ages; thatched huts, earthen steps; no pictures, no paintings.

sentences.zh: 黃屋心齋，不築崔嵬。

translations.literal: Yellow house, heart in fasting; no building of towering height.
translations.idiomatic: Yellow house, heart in fasting; no building of towering height.

sentences.zh: 不重玫瑰，不貴腥膻菹醢。

translations.literal: Not valuing rose gems; not prizing rank meat, minced and pickled.
translations.idiomatic: Not valuing rose gems; not prizing rank meat, minced and pickled.

sentences.zh: 卻猩脣，減豹胎，惟寶賢才。

translations.literal: Set aside orangutan lips; reduce leopard foetus; only treasure worthy talent.
translations.idiomatic: Set aside orangutan lips; reduce leopard foetus; only treasure worthy talent.

sentences.zh: 亦有鹽梅和舟楫，九棘三槐。

translations.literal: Also salt and plum harmonize, boats and oars; nine jujubes, three pagoda trees.
translations.idiomatic: Also salt and plum harmonize, boats and oars; nine jujubes, three pagoda trees.

sentences.zh: 念民依，飢渴殷懷，原時和，田不汙萊，神倉御廩藏精粺。

translations.literal: Think of the people's reliance; hunger and thirst in earnest heart; pray for timely harmony; fields not fouled and wasteland; divine granary, imperial storehouse hoard fine grain.
translations.idiomatic: Think of the people's reliance; hunger and thirst in earnest heart; pray for timely harmony; fields not fouled and wasteland; divine granary, imperial storehouse hoard fine grain.

sentences.zh: 五風十雨，無僭無差。

translations.literal: Five winds, ten rains; no excess, no shortfall.
translations.idiomatic: Five winds, ten rains; no excess, no shortfall.

sentences.zh: 十解日晶熒，雲靉靆，蓂葉芳生玉階。

translations.literal: Tenth stanza: sun crystal-bright; clouds dark and dense; rank-birthwort leaves fragrant on jade steps.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza X: sun crystal-bright; clouds dark and dense; rank-birthwort leaves fragrant on jade steps.

sentences.zh: 紺露丹霞接上台，帝居深在蓬萊。

translations.literal: Dark dew, red clouds connect to the upper terrace; the Emperor dwells deep in Penglai.
translations.idiomatic: Dark dew, red clouds connect to the upper terrace; the Emperor dwells deep in Penglai.

sentences.zh: 泛瑤觴，玉斝雲罍，宮漏銅壺緩緩催。

translations.literal: Pour jade goblets; jade cups, cloud urns; palace clepsydra, bronze vessel slowly urges.
translations.idiomatic: Pour jade goblets; jade cups, cloud urns; palace clepsydra, bronze vessel slowly urges.

sentences.zh: 頌元首明哉，喜君賡臣拜，太平時節萬年杯。

translations.literal: Praise the head: "How bright!" Joy: the lord continues, ministers bow; Great Peace season—ten-thousand-year cup.
translations.idiomatic: Praise the head: "How bright!" Joy: the lord continues, ministers bow; Great Peace season—ten-thousand-year cup.

sentences.zh: 趨辭

translations.literal: Refrain for approaching.
translations.idiomatic: Approach refrain.

sentences.zh: 進饌萬象清寧之章萬象清寧，海承平，瑞日麗彤廷。

translations.literal: Presenting viands—the stanza "Ten Thousand Images Clear and Still": ten thousand images clear and still; sea at peace; auspicious sun beautiful at the red court.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting viands—movement "Ten Thousand Images Clear and Still": ten thousand images clear and still; sea at peace; auspicious sun beautiful at the red court.

sentences.zh: 乾主大生，坤職資生，四序不言而成。

translations.literal: Qian governs great birth; Kun's office provides birth; four seasons without speech yet accomplished.
translations.idiomatic: Qian governs great birth; Kun's office provides birth; four seasons without speech yet accomplished.

sentences.zh: 宸居端拱敷皇極，帝道無為法健行。

translations.literal: The palace dwells upright, hands folded, spreading the imperial apex; the imperial Way without exertion models vigorous action.
translations.idiomatic: The palace dwells upright, hands folded, spreading the imperial apex; the imperial Way without exertion models vigorous action.

sentences.zh: 五緯明，百度貞，萬邦額手歡慶。

translations.literal: Five luminaries bright; hundred measures correct; ten thousand states forehead to hand in joyful celebration.
translations.idiomatic: Five luminaries bright; hundred measures correct; ten thousand states forehead to hand in joyful celebration.

sentences.zh: 一解軒圖麗日懸金鏡，堯階蓂莢舒長景。

translations.literal: First stanza: the chart of the hall, beautiful sun hangs the golden mirror; Yao's steps, rank-birthwort pods stretch the long scene.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza I: the chart of the hall, beautiful sun hangs the golden mirror; Yao's steps, rank-birthwort pods stretch the long scene.

sentences.zh: 陽回黍谷開春令，帝車運轉杓攜柄。

translations.literal: Yang returns to the millet valley—spring command opens; the Emperor's carriage turns, ladle carries the handle.
translations.idiomatic: Yang returns to the millet valley—spring command opens; the Emperor's carriage turns, ladle carries the handle.

sentences.zh: 天道本無言，主德惟居敬，萬邦咸頌吾皇聖。

translations.literal: Heaven's Way originally without words; the ruler's virtue only dwells in reverence; ten thousand states all praise our Emperor's sageliness.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's Way originally without words; the ruler's virtue only dwells in reverence; ten thousand states all praise our Emperor's sageliness.

sentences.zh: 二解歡幸，累洽重熙際太平，萬國獻葵誠。

translations.literal: Second stanza: joyful fortune; accumulated harmony, repeated splendor at the border of Great Peace; ten thousand states offer sunflower sincerity.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza II: joyful fortune; accumulated harmony, repeated splendor at the border of Great Peace; ten thousand states offer sunflower sincerity.

sentences.zh: 簪紱盈廷，筐篚充庭。

translations.literal: Hairpins and ribbons fill the court; baskets and bundles fill the hall.
translations.idiomatic: Hairpins and ribbons fill the court; baskets and bundles fill the hall.

sentences.zh: 圖王會，奏咸英。

translations.literal: Chart of royal assembly; perform Xian and Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Chart of royal assembly; perform Xian and Ying.

sentences.zh: 微颸不動珠簾卷，露漙漙，仙掌高擎。

translations.literal: Light breeze unmoved—pearl curtains roll; dew drips thick; immortal palm raised high.
translations.idiomatic: Light breeze unmoved—pearl curtains roll; dew drips thick; immortal palm raised high.

sentences.zh: 酒初馨，薦瑤觥，共祝一人有慶。

translations.literal: Wine first fragrant; offer jade goblet; together bless: one man has celebration.
translations.idiomatic: Wine first fragrant; offer jade goblet; together bless: one man has celebration.

sentences.zh: 三解彤墀上，花磚布影。

translations.literal: Third stanza: upon the red steps; flower bricks spread shadow.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza III: upon the red steps; flower bricks spread shadow.

sentences.zh: 瑤階上，爐煙細生。

translations.literal: Upon jade steps; censer smoke finely born.
translations.idiomatic: Upon jade steps; censer smoke finely born.

sentences.zh: 鳳凰鳷鵲敞雲屏，宮漏悄，玉壺清。

translations.literal: Phoenix, zhi, and que open cloud screens; palace clepsydra quiet; jade pot clear.
translations.idiomatic: Phoenix, zhi, and que open cloud screens; palace clepsydra quiet; jade pot clear.

sentences.zh: 四解泰階久平，大有屢登。

translations.literal: Fourth stanza: the Grand Stair long peaceful; Great Abundance repeatedly ascends.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza IV: the Grand Stair long peaceful; Great Abundance repeatedly ascends.

sentences.zh: 上林草木瑞光凝，卿雲景星。

translations.literal: Upper Park grass and trees—auspicious light congeals; auspicious clouds, splendid stars.
translations.idiomatic: Upper Park grass and trees—auspicious light congeals; auspicious clouds, splendid stars.

sentences.zh: 梯航萬國冠裳整，香煙盎盎排蓮井。

translations.literal: Ladders and ships, ten thousand states—caps and robes orderly; incense smoke rich, rich—arrayed at the lotus well.
translations.idiomatic: Ladders and ships, ten thousand states—caps and robes orderly; incense smoke rich, rich—arrayed at the lotus well.

sentences.zh: 宮殿風微仙樂盈，九成韶箾來儀鳳，穆肅天容睟以清。

translations.literal: Palace breeze slight; immortal music full; nine movements Xiao-Shao, coming ceremony phoenix; solemn, respectful heavenly countenance clear and pure.
translations.idiomatic: Palace breeze slight; immortal music full; nine movements Xiao-Shao, coming ceremony phoenix; solemn, respectful heavenly countenance clear and pure.

sentences.zh: 五解庭燎初炳，仰垂裳，一人有慶。

translations.literal: Fifth stanza: courtyard torches first blaze; look up to draped robes; one man has celebration.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza V: courtyard torches first blaze; look up to draped robes; one man has celebration.

sentences.zh: 明離午正，又千道彩霞籠瑞景。

translations.literal: Bright Li at noon correct; again a thousand paths—colored clouds enfold auspicious scene.
translations.idiomatic: Bright Li at noon correct; again a thousand paths—colored clouds enfold auspicious scene.

sentences.zh: 西山瓘瓘分翠黛，共南山獻壽，北斗天漿溟涬。

translations.literal: Western hills jade-bright divide emerald-black; together the southern mountain offers longevity; Northern Dipper, celestial nectar, vast and deep.
translations.idiomatic: Western hills jade-bright divide emerald-black; together the southern mountain offers longevity; Northern Dipper, celestial nectar, vast and deep.

sentences.zh: 天長地久，永茲九野盈寧，萬方綏定。

translations.literal: Heaven long, earth enduring; forever here—nine fields full and still; ten thousand directions pacified and fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven long, earth enduring; forever here—nine fields full and still; ten thousand directions pacified and fixed.

sentences.zh: 六解念世德，承天命，況復寶籙鴻圖，嘉祥歲歲呈。

translations.literal: Sixth stanza: think of the age's virtue; receive Heaven's mandate; moreover the precious register, great chart—auspicious signs year after year appear.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza VI: think of the age's virtue; receive Heaven's mandate; moreover the precious register, great chart—auspicious signs year after year appear.

sentences.zh: 五風十雨，九穗雙歧，紫芝硃草榮。

translations.literal: Five winds, ten rains; nine ears, double branches; purple fungus, cinnabar grass flourish.
translations.idiomatic: Five winds, ten rains; nine ears, double branches; purple fungus, cinnabar grass flourish.

sentences.zh: 木華連理，更兼之，屈軼階前指佞。

translations.literal: Tree flower joined in reason; moreover this—crooked yew before the steps points at flatterers.
translations.idiomatic: Tree flower joined in reason; moreover this—crooked yew before the steps points at flatterers.

sentences.zh: 七解欣慶，際昌期，觀聖政。

translations.literal: Seventh stanza: joyful celebration; at the flourishing term; observe sagely government.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza VII: joyful celebration; at the flourishing term; observe sagely government.

sentences.zh: 億萬載，培周鼎。

translations.literal: Hundreds of millions of generations; cultivate the Zhou tripod.
translations.idiomatic: Hundreds of millions of generations; cultivate the Zhou tripod.

sentences.zh: 宵衣旰食，日邁月征。

translations.literal: Rise at dawn, eat at dusk; day advancing, month proceeding.
translations.idiomatic: Rise at dawn, eat at dusk; day advancing, month proceeding.

sentences.zh: 殫厥心，為民求瘼，菖葉抽時花綻杏。

translations.literal: Exhaust the heart; for the people seek relief; iris leaf draws forth—flowers bloom on apricot.
translations.idiomatic: Exhaust the heart; for the people seek relief; iris leaf draws forth—flowers bloom on apricot.

sentences.zh: 寫豳風，又思省，春省秋省。

translations.literal: Write the Bin winds; again think and reflect; spring inspection, autumn inspection.
translations.idiomatic: Write the Bin winds; again think and reflect; spring inspection, autumn inspection.

sentences.zh: 八解玉振金聲，皇朝功德慶成。

translations.literal: Eighth stanza: jade vibration, golden sound; the dynasty's merit and virtue celebration complete.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza VIII: jade vibration, golden sound; the dynasty's merit and virtue celebration complete.

sentences.zh: 從此年年獻兕觥，佳節良辰喜交並。

translations.literal: From this year after year offer rhino goblets; fine season, fine day—joy intersects and joins.
translations.idiomatic: From this year after year offer rhino goblets; fine season, fine day—joy intersects and joins.

sentences.zh: 傾堯酒，堯棟雲生，壽籙綿綿天共永。

translations.literal: Pour Yao's wine; Yao's beam, clouds born; longevity register continuous—heaven together eternal.
translations.idiomatic: Pour Yao's wine; Yao's beam, clouds born; longevity register continuous—heaven together eternal.

sentences.zh: 趨辭

translations.literal: Refrain for approaching.
translations.idiomatic: Approach refrain.

sentences.zh: 除夕、上元、上燈火樹星橋一章乾隆七年定。

translations.literal: New Year's Eve, Lantern Festival, lamp-lighting—one stanza "Fire Trees, Star Bridge," fixed in the seventh year of the Qianlong reign.
translations.idiomatic: New Year's Eve, Lantern Festival, lamp-lighting—one movement "Fire Trees, Star Bridge," established in Qianlong 7.

sentences.zh: 中和清樂齋火樹星橋，爛煌煌，鐙月連宵夜如晝。

translations.literal: Zhonghe Clear Music for fasting: fire trees, star bridge; blazing, brilliant; lamps and moon link night after night—bright as noon.
translations.idiomatic: Zhonghe Clear Music for fasting: fire trees, star bridge; blazing, brilliant; lamps and moon link night after night—bright as noon.

sentences.zh: 春風料峭，鈞天奏徹箾韶。

translations.literal: Spring wind biting cold; Juntian played through—Xiao-Shao ends.
translations.idiomatic: Spring wind biting cold; Juntian played through—Xiao-Shao ends.

sentences.zh: 煙雲中，瑞靄交，籠著鮫綃。

translations.literal: Within smoke and clouds; auspicious mist crosses; enfolds shark silk.
translations.idiomatic: Within smoke and clouds; auspicious mist crosses; enfolds shark silk.

sentences.zh: 錦繡叢，萬花繚繞。

translations.literal: Brocade clusters; ten thousand flowers twine and surround.
translations.idiomatic: Brocade clusters; ten thousand flowers twine and surround.

sentences.zh: 魚龍夭矯，嵩祝聲高。

translations.literal: Fish and dragon twist and soar; Song praise voices high.
translations.idiomatic: Fish and dragon twist and soar; Song praise voices high.

sentences.zh: 一解分明是洞天，是絳霄。

translations.literal: First stanza: clearly it is a grotto heaven; it is crimson sky.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza I: clearly it is a grotto heaven; it is crimson sky.

sentences.zh: 分明是靈台靈囿靈沼。

translations.literal: Clearly it is the Spirit Terrace, Spirit Park, Spirit Pond.
translations.idiomatic: Clearly it is the Spirit Terrace, Spirit Park, Spirit Pond.

sentences.zh: 更春光乍到，景物暄妍雨露饒。

translations.literal: Moreover spring light suddenly arrives; scenery warm and beautiful—rain and dew abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover spring light suddenly arrives; scenery warm and beautiful—rain and dew abundant.

sentences.zh: 又黃上柳條，漏泄春陽在野橋。

translations.literal: Again yellow on willow branches; leaks spring sun at the wild bridge.
translations.idiomatic: Again yellow on willow branches; leaks spring sun at the wild bridge.

sentences.zh: 二解賀聖朝，世德遙。

translations.literal: Second stanza: celebrate the sagely court; age's virtue far.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza II: celebrate the sagely court; age's virtue far.

sentences.zh: 郁曈曨，日麗霄。

translations.literal: Luxuriant, bright and hazy; sun beautiful at the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Luxuriant, bright and hazy; sun beautiful at the sky.

sentences.zh: 聖嗣聖，重明繼照。

translations.literal: Sage succeeds sage; double brightness continues to shine.
translations.idiomatic: Sage succeeds sage; double brightness continues to shine.

sentences.zh: 萬民歡樂，萬方熙皋。

translations.literal: Ten thousand people joyful; ten thousand directions prosperous and high.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand people joyful; ten thousand directions prosperous and high.

sentences.zh: 昇平節，瑞應昭，瓊蕊飄蕭。

translations.literal: Ascending Peace festival; auspicious response declared; jade pistils drift and blow.
translations.idiomatic: Ascending Peace festival; auspicious response declared; jade pistils drift and blow.

sentences.zh: 寶殿開，法曲雲璈。

translations.literal: Precious hall opens; ritual melody cloud-gongs.
translations.idiomatic: Precious hall opens; ritual melody cloud-gongs.

sentences.zh: 魚龍夭矯，嵩祝聲高。

translations.literal: Fish and dragon twist and soar; Song praise voices high.
translations.idiomatic: Fish and dragon twist and soar; Song praise voices high.

sentences.zh: 三解金枝麝氣飄，西吠琉璃四照。

translations.literal: Third stanza: golden branch, musk qi drifts; western bark, glazed tiles shine fourfold.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza III: golden branch, musk qi drifts; western bark, glazed tiles shine fourfold.

sentences.zh: 影娥池，鳳燭燒，百子池，涎爇龍膏。

translations.literal: Shadow-Moon Pool; phoenix candles burn; Hundred-Sons Pool; wax melts dragon paste.
translations.idiomatic: Shadow-Moon Pool; phoenix candles burn; Hundred-Sons Pool; wax melts dragon paste.

sentences.zh: 九華鐙，篆煙消。

translations.literal: Nine-flower lamps; seal incense dissipated.
translations.idiomatic: Nine-flower lamps; seal incense dissipated.

sentences.zh: 寒星累累綴銀霄，蟻穿九曲珠光耀。

translations.literal: Cold stars clustered cluster adorn silver sky; ants thread nine bends—pearl light shines.
translations.idiomatic: Cold stars clustered cluster adorn silver sky; ants thread nine bends—pearl light shines.

sentences.zh: 好良宵，是皇家，景福滔滔。

translations.literal: Fine good night; it is the royal house—splendid fortune vast and wide.
translations.idiomatic: Fine good night; it is the royal house—splendid fortune vast and wide.

sentences.zh: 四解滿山椒花簇，百枝嬌，月輪正高。

translations.literal: Fourth stanza: full mountain pepper flowers cluster; a hundred branches delicate; moon wheel just high.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza IV: full mountain pepper flowers cluster; a hundred branches delicate; moon wheel just high.

sentences.zh: 鐙和月，一片冰霄，是皇家，景福滔滔。

translations.literal: Lamps and moon; one slice of icy sky; it is the royal house—splendid fortune vast and wide.
translations.idiomatic: Lamps and moon; one slice of icy sky; it is the royal house—splendid fortune vast and wide.

sentences.zh: 五解殿當中，黼座高，春悄銅壺漫敲。

translations.literal: Fifth stanza: hall at center; embroidered throne high; spring quiet—bronze clepsydra slowly taps.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza V: hall at center; embroidered throne high; spring quiet—bronze clepsydra slowly taps.

sentences.zh: 笙歌千萬里而遙，是皇家，景福滔滔。

translations.literal: Flute and song a thousand li distant; it is the royal house—splendid fortune vast and wide.
translations.idiomatic: Flute and song a thousand li distant; it is the royal house—splendid fortune vast and wide.

sentences.zh: 六解良宵正好，正好良宵。

translations.literal: Sixth stanza: fine night just right; just right, fine night.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza VI: fine night just right; just right, fine night.

sentences.zh: 看皇都，萬井多娛樂。

translations.literal: Behold the imperial capital; ten thousand wells much joy.
translations.idiomatic: Behold the imperial capital; ten thousand wells much joy.

sentences.zh: 良宵正好，正好良宵，蓬壺清窈，銀海光搖。

translations.literal: Fine night just right; just right, fine night; Penglai clear and deep; silver sea light sways.
translations.idiomatic: Fine night just right; just right, fine night; Penglai clear and deep; silver sea light sways.

sentences.zh: 百和香，霏瑤島；

translations.literal: A hundred blended fragrances; mist on jade isle;
translations.idiomatic: A hundred blended fragrances; mist on jade isle;

sentences.zh: 紫羅囊，綉采飄。

translations.literal: Purple silk pouch; embroidered colors drift.
translations.idiomatic: Purple silk pouch; embroidered colors drift.

sentences.zh: 花匼匝，東風吹飽，同慶清朝。

translations.literal: Flowers clustered all around; east wind blows full; together celebrate the clear court.
translations.idiomatic: Flowers clustered all around; east wind blows full; together celebrate the clear court.

sentences.zh: 七解小梅梢，暗香浮動，淡煙籠罩。

translations.literal: Seventh stanza: small plum branch tips; hidden fragrance stirs; light smoke enfolds.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza VII: small plum branch tips; hidden fragrance stirs; light smoke enfolds.

sentences.zh: 月上柔枝，露滴輕苞。

translations.literal: Moon on soft branches; dew drips on light buds.
translations.idiomatic: Moon on soft branches; dew drips on light buds.

sentences.zh: 今宵里，巷舞衢歌，遍寰瀛，同慶清朝。

translations.literal: This night within; lane dance, thoroughfare song; throughout the realm; together celebrate the clear court.
translations.idiomatic: This night within; lane dance, thoroughfare song; throughout the realm; together celebrate the clear court.

sentences.zh: 八解原春光，年年好，三五迢迢。

translations.literal: Eighth stanza: original spring light; year after year fine; third and fifth distant and far.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza VIII: original spring light; year after year fine; third and fifth distant and far.

sentences.zh: 不夜城，燈月交，奉宸歡，暮暮朝朝。

translations.literal: City without night; lamps and moon cross; serve imperial joy—evening after evening, morning after morning.
translations.idiomatic: City without night; lamps and moon cross; serve imperial joy—evening after evening, morning after morning.

sentences.zh: 成矞成卿，萬朵祥雲護帝霄。

translations.literal: Become splendid, become auspicious; ten thousand clusters auspicious clouds guard the imperial sky.
translations.idiomatic: Become splendid, become auspicious; ten thousand clusters auspicious clouds guard the imperial sky.

sentences.zh: 趨辭

translations.literal: Refrain for approaching.
translations.idiomatic: Approach refrain.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年，耕耤禮成，筵宴三章

translations.literal: Second year of the Yongzheng reign: when the plowing rite was complete, banquet—three stanzas.
translations.idiomatic: Yongzheng 2: when the plowing rite was complete, banquet—three movements.

sentences.zh: 進茶雨暘時若之章祥開黼座兮，布瓊筵。

translations.literal: Presenting tea—the stanza "Rain and Sunshine Timely": auspicious opening of the embroidered throne; spread jade banquet.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting tea—movement "Rain and Sunshine Timely": auspicious opening of the embroidered throne; spread jade banquet.

sentences.zh: 笙歌迭奏兮，天樂宣。

translations.literal: Flute and song play in turn; heavenly music proclaims.
translations.idiomatic: Flute and song play in turn; heavenly music proclaims.

sentences.zh: 三推既舉兮，賜豐年。

translations.literal: Three pushes already raised; bestow abundant year.
translations.idiomatic: Three pushes already raised; bestow abundant year.

sentences.zh: 五風十雨兮，時不愆。

translations.literal: Five winds, ten rains; seasons without fault.
translations.idiomatic: Five winds, ten rains; seasons without fault.

sentences.zh: 優渥霑足兮，溉大田。

translations.literal: Rich favor moistens enough; irrigate great fields.
translations.idiomatic: Rich favor moistens enough; irrigate great fields.

sentences.zh: 皇心悅豫兮，福祿綿。

translations.literal: Imperial heart joyful and pleased; fortune and emolument continuous.
