translations.idiomatic: Imperial heart joyful and pleased; fortune and emolument continuous.

sentences.zh: 進酒五穀豐登之章龍犁轉兮，春風生。

translations.literal: Presenting wine—the stanza "Five Grains Abundant": dragon plow turns; spring wind born.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting wine—movement "Five Grains Abundant": dragon plow turns; spring wind born.

sentences.zh: 帝勤稼穡兮，供粢盛。

translations.literal: The Emperor diligent in planting and harvest; supplies grain offerings.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor diligent in planting and harvest; supplies grain offerings.

sentences.zh: 戒農用兮，勸服耕。

translations.literal: Admonish farm use; encourage wearing and plowing.
translations.idiomatic: Admonish farm use; encourage wearing and plowing.

sentences.zh: 富教化行兮，百穀成。

translations.literal: Rich teaching and transformation move; a hundred grains accomplished.
translations.idiomatic: Rich teaching and transformation move; a hundred grains accomplished.

sentences.zh: 禾九穗兮，麥兩莖。

translations.literal: Grain nine ears; wheat two stalks.
translations.idiomatic: Grain nine ears; wheat two stalks.

sentences.zh: 黍稷重穋兮，充棟楹。

translations.literal: Millet and sacrificial grain, heavy ears; fill beams and pillars.
translations.idiomatic: Millet and sacrificial grain, heavy ears; fill beams and pillars.

sentences.zh: 歲登大有兮，怡聖情。

translations.literal: Year ascends Great Abundance; delights the sagely heart.
translations.idiomatic: Year ascends Great Abundance; delights the sagely heart.

sentences.zh: 堯樽特進兮，玉醴盈。

translations.literal: Yao's goblet specially advanced; jade nectar full.
translations.idiomatic: Yao's goblet specially advanced; jade nectar full.

sentences.zh: 勞酒禮飲兮，邁鎬京。

translations.literal: Labor-wine rite, drink; surpass the capital of Hao.
translations.idiomatic: Labor-wine rite, drink; surpass the capital of Hao.

sentences.zh: 進饌家給人足之章嘉禾炊饌兮，雲子芳。

translations.literal: Presenting viands—the stanza "Fine Grain Cooked Fare": fine grain cooked fare; cloud-seed fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting viands—movement "Fine Grain Cooked Fare": fine grain cooked fare; cloud-seed fragrant.

sentences.zh: 仙廚瓊粒兮，匕箸香。

translations.literal: Immortal kitchen jade grains; spoon and chopsticks fragrant.
translations.idiomatic: Immortal kitchen jade grains; spoon and chopsticks fragrant.

sentences.zh: 吾皇重農兮，禮肅將。

translations.literal: Our Emperor values agriculture; rites solemn, about to proceed.
translations.idiomatic: Our Emperor values agriculture; rites solemn, about to proceed.

sentences.zh: 明昭感格兮，錫嘉祥。

translations.literal: Bright illumination, feeling and reaching; bestows fine auspice.
translations.idiomatic: Bright illumination, feeling and reaching; bestows fine auspice.

sentences.zh: 千倉萬箱兮，百穀穰。

translations.literal: Thousand granaries, ten thousand bins; a hundred grains abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Thousand granaries, ten thousand bins; a hundred grains abundant.

sentences.zh: 崇墉比櫛兮，遙相望。

translations.literal: Lofty walls like comb teeth; from afar gaze at each other.
translations.idiomatic: Lofty walls like comb teeth; from afar gaze at each other.

sentences.zh: 豐亨樂利兮，遍八方。

translations.literal: Abundant, prosperous joy and benefit; throughout eight directions.
translations.idiomatic: Abundant, prosperous joy and benefit; throughout eight directions.

sentences.zh: 家多充積兮，野餘糧。

translations.literal: Homes much stored; fields with surplus grain.
translations.idiomatic: Homes much stored; fields with surplus grain.

sentences.zh: 含哺鼓腹兮，化日長。

translations.literal: Mouths full, bellies drum; transforming sun long.
translations.idiomatic: Mouths full, bellies drum; transforming sun long.

sentences.zh: 朝饔夕飧兮，壽而康。

translations.literal: Morning porridge, evening meal; longevity and health.
translations.idiomatic: Morning porridge, evening meal; longevity and health.

sentences.zh: 萬邦同慶兮，璿圖昌。

translations.literal: Ten thousand states together celebrate; jade chart flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand states together celebrate; jade chart flourishing.

sentences.zh: 乾隆七年，重定耕耤筵宴三章進茶、進酒丹陛清樂，進饌中和清樂

translations.literal: Seventh year of the Qianlong reign, re-fixed plowing banquet—three stanzas for presenting tea and wine: Danbi Clear Music; presenting viands: Zhonghe Clear Music.
translations.idiomatic: Qianlong 7, re-fixed plowing banquet—three movements for presenting tea and wine: Danbi Clear Music; for presenting dishes: Zhonghe Clear Music.

sentences.zh: 進茶喜春光之章喜春光，將瑞靄集，斗杓運，農祥正，土脈融。

translations.literal: Presenting tea—the stanza "Joy in Spring Light": joy in spring light; will gather auspicious mist; Dipper handle moves; farm omens correct; soil breath melts.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting tea—movement "Joy in Spring Light": joy in spring light; will gather auspicious mist; Dipper handle moves; farm omens correct; soil breath melts.

sentences.zh: 平野水泉滋，景風至，農夫塗脛。

translations.literal: Level fields, springs moisten; splendid wind arrives; farmers smear shins.
translations.idiomatic: Level fields, springs moisten; splendid wind arrives; farmers smear shins.

sentences.zh: 長堤柳，繭館條桑映。

translations.literal: Long embankment willows; silkworm hall mulberry reflects.
translations.idiomatic: Long embankment willows; silkworm hall mulberry reflects.

sentences.zh: 蓑共笠，村謳相永。

translations.literal: Rain-cape together, bamboo hat; village songs answer forever.
translations.idiomatic: Rain-cape together, bamboo hat; village songs answer forever.

sentences.zh: 頌元後，眉壽萬年；

translations.literal: Praise the first sovereign; eyebrow longevity ten thousand years;
translations.idiomatic: Praise the first sovereign; eyebrow longevity ten thousand years;

sentences.zh: 育我民，四方歡慶。

translations.literal: Nurture our people; four directions joyful celebration.
translations.idiomatic: Nurture our people; four directions joyful celebration.

sentences.zh: 一解看風烏翔玉樹外，帝座臨瑤階影。

translations.literal: First stanza: behold wind-birds fly outside jade trees; imperial seat overlooks jade steps' shadow.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza I: behold wind-birds fly outside jade trees; imperial seat overlooks jade steps' shadow.

sentences.zh: 百辟趨，搢笏共朝天，摳衣拜，田夫瞻望，簫韶奏，磬管聲依永。

translations.literal: Hundred officials hurry; insert tablets together face heaven; pluck robes bow; farmers gaze up; Xiao-Shao plays; stone pipes' sound follows forever.
translations.idiomatic: Hundred officials hurry; insert tablets together face heaven; pluck robes bow; farmers gaze up; Xiao-Shao plays; stone pipes' sound follows forever.

sentences.zh: 寢園內，硃櫻初迸。

translations.literal: Within the imperial park; cinnabar cherries first burst.
translations.idiomatic: Within the imperial park; cinnabar cherries first burst.

sentences.zh: 玉井藕，十丈移根，安期棗，似瓜晶瑩。

translations.literal: Jade well lotus root; ten fathoms transplanted root; Anqi jujube; like melon crystal bright.
translations.idiomatic: Jade well lotus root; ten fathoms transplanted root; Anqi jujube; like melon crystal bright.

sentences.zh: 二解是瑤池來，閬苑薦，世間物，如何並。

translations.literal: Second stanza: it is from Jade Pool come; Lang Garden offered; worldly things—how can they compare.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza II: it is from Jade Pool come; Lang Garden offered; worldly things—how can they compare.

sentences.zh: 嵰雪甜，王母遠相將，笑留核，冰桃還勝。

translations.literal: Mountain-snow sweet; Queen Mother from afar accompanies; laugh, leave the pit; ice peach still surpasses.
translations.idiomatic: Mountain-snow sweet; Queen Mother from afar accompanies; laugh, leave the pit; ice peach still surpasses.

sentences.zh: 吾皇念，菽粟真民命，異物捐，芳甘俱屏。

translations.literal: Our Emperor thinks: grain and millet—truly the people's life; strange things discarded; fragrant sweetness all screened.
translations.idiomatic: Our Emperor thinks: grain and millet—truly the people's life; strange things discarded; fragrant sweetness all screened.

sentences.zh: 富方穀，在歲有秋，勞則思，若時恆性。

translations.literal: Abundance in the granaries; in the year there is autumn; labor then thought—like the season's constant nature.
translations.idiomatic: Abundance in the granaries; in the year there is autumn; labor then thought—like the season's constant nature.

sentences.zh: 三解辨土宜，頌月令。

translations.literal: Third stanza: distinguish soil's suitability; praise the monthly command.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza III: distinguish soil's suitability; praise the monthly command.

sentences.zh: 遍紫陌，野人望杏。

translations.literal: Throughout purple thoroughfare; country people gaze at apricot.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout purple thoroughfare; country people gaze at apricot.

sentences.zh: 玉盤待賜，紅垂上苑櫻。

translations.literal: Jade tray awaits bestowal; red hangs—upper garden cherry.
translations.idiomatic: Jade tray awaits bestowal; red hangs—upper garden cherry.

sentences.zh: 趨辭

translations.literal: Refrain for approaching.
translations.idiomatic: Approach refrain.

sentences.zh: 進酒雲和迭奏之章雲和迭奏，聽倉庚載鳴，玉壺清漏。

translations.literal: Presenting wine—the stanza "Cloud Harmony Plays in Turn": cloud harmony plays in turn; hear the oriole carry its cry; jade pot clear clepsydra.
translations.idiomatic: Presenting wine—movement "Cloud Harmony Plays in Turn": cloud harmony plays in turn; hear the oriole carry its cry; jade pot clear clepsydra.

sentences.zh: 萬井歡娛，桑柘陰濃綠樹稠。

translations.literal: Ten thousand wells joyful; mulberry and pagoda tree shade thick, green trees dense.
translations.idiomatic: Ten thousand wells joyful; mulberry and pagoda tree shade thick, green trees dense.

sentences.zh: 紅牆外，柳絲微嚲鴉黃瘦，更桃李暄妍晴晝。

translations.literal: Outside red wall; willow threads slightly droop—crow yellow thin; moreover peach and plum warm and beautiful, clear noon.
translations.idiomatic: Outside red wall; willow threads slightly droop—crow yellow thin; moreover peach and plum warm and beautiful, clear noon.

sentences.zh: 聖天子勞民勸相，今日青轅黛耜，芳塍如綉。

translations.literal: The sagely Son of Heaven labors the people, encourages mutual aid; today green shafts, dark plow; fragrant fields like embroidery.
translations.idiomatic: The sagely Son of Heaven labors the people, encourages mutual aid; today green shafts, dark plow; fragrant fields like embroidery.

sentences.zh: 一解霞觴獻壽，原吾皇萬年，與天齊耇。

translations.literal: First stanza: rosy goblet offers longevity; pray our Emperor ten thousand years, with heaven together aged.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza I: rosy goblet offers longevity; pray our Emperor ten thousand years, with heaven together aged.

sentences.zh: 玉斝金罍，柏葉芳馨綠蟻浮。

translations.literal: Jade cups, golden urns; cypress leaves fragrant, green ants float.
translations.idiomatic: Jade cups, golden urns; cypress leaves fragrant, green ants float.

sentences.zh: 彤墀下，緋衣玉帶兼青綬，更父老摳趨在後。

translations.literal: Below red steps; scarlet robes, jade belts together with green cords; moreover elders pluck and hurry behind.
translations.idiomatic: Below red steps; scarlet robes, jade belts together with green cords; moreover elders pluck and hurry behind.

sentences.zh: 共慶祝皇圖鞏固，從此五風十雨，年年大有。

translations.literal: Together celebrate the imperial chart secured; from this five winds, ten rains; year after year Great Abundance.
translations.idiomatic: Together celebrate the imperial chart secured; from this five winds, ten rains; year after year Great Abundance.

sentences.zh: 二解皇心在宥，念春風始和，不忘耕耨。

translations.literal: Second stanza: imperial heart in leniency; thinks spring wind just harmonious; does not forget plowing and hoeing.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza II: imperial heart in leniency; thinks spring wind just harmonious; does not forget plowing and hoeing.

sentences.zh: 婦子盈寧，宵旰仍懷飢溺憂。

translations.literal: Wives and children full and peaceful; dawn and dusk still cherish hunger and drowning worry.
translations.idiomatic: Wives and children full and peaceful; dawn and dusk still cherish hunger and drowning worry.

sentences.zh: 深宮內，心齋常屏瑤池酒，喜天耤既栽黃茂。

translations.literal: Deep within the palace; heart fasting constantly screens Jade Pool wine; joy: heaven's field already planted yellow lush.
translations.idiomatic: Deep within the palace; heart fasting constantly screens Jade Pool wine; joy: heaven's field already planted yellow lush.

sentences.zh: 坐廣廈，與民同樂，但見遐阡邇陌，黃童白叟。

translations.literal: Sit in broad mansion; with the people same joy; only behold distant fields, nearby paths; yellow lads, white elders.
translations.idiomatic: Sit in broad mansion; with the people same joy; only behold distant fields, nearby paths; yellow lads, white elders.

sentences.zh: 三解芳旨陳，金石奏。

translations.literal: Third stanza: fragrant delicacies spread; metal and stone play.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza III: fragrant delicacies spread; metal and stone play.

translations.literal: Bestow on Military Presented Scholar household banquet—"Harmony Reaches" one movement, established Qianlong 7.
translations.idiomatic: Bestow on Military Presented Scholar household banquet—"Harmony Reaches" one movement, established Qianlong 7.

sentences.zh: 五十年，改奏兔罝詩三章。

translations.literal: Fiftieth year—changed to perform "Rabbit Snare" ode three stanzas.
translations.idiomatic: Fiftieth year—changed to perform "Rabbit Snare" ode three stanzas.

sentences.zh: 和氣洽，泰階平。

translations.literal: Harmony reaches; Grand Stair peaceful.
translations.idiomatic: Harmony reaches; Grand Stair peaceful.

sentences.zh: 皇威截，烽煙靖。

translations.literal: Imperial might cuts off; beacon smoke pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial might cuts off; beacon smoke pacified.

sentences.zh: 念兔罝，亦有干城，虎頭猿臂交相慶。

translations.literal: Think rabbit snare also has wall for the state; tiger head, ape arm—mutual celebration.
translations.idiomatic: Think rabbit snare also has wall for the state; tiger head, ape arm—mutual celebration.

sentences.zh: 看雕翮，秋來勁。

translations.literal: Behold carved wings; autumn comes—strength.
translations.idiomatic: Behold carved wings; autumn comes—strength.

sentences.zh: 一解須知道，羽扇綸巾，還有那，弓強箭勁。

translations.literal: First stanza: must know; feather fan, silk kerchief; moreover there is; bow strong, arrow keen.
translations.idiomatic: Stanza I: must know; feather fan, silk kerchief; moreover there is; bow strong, arrow keen.

sentences.zh: 更兼之，武庫縱橫。

translations.literal: Moreover; arsenal storehouse traverses.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover; arsenal storehouse traverses.

sentences.zh: 效折衝，驊騮騁。

translations.literal: Effect repelling foe; piebald steeds gallop.
translations.idiomatic: Effect repelling foe; piebald steeds gallop.

sentences.zh: 執戈殳，衛羽林，備公侯腹心。

translations.literal: Hold dagger-axe; guard feathered forest; prepare for lords and nobles—the heart.
translations.idiomatic: Hold dagger-axe; guard feathered forest; prepare for lords and nobles—the heart.

sentences.zh: 二解

translations.literal: Second stanza:
translations.idiomatic: Stanza II:

sentences.zh: 鄉飲酒高宗自製補笙詩六章

translations.literal: Village drinking ceremony—Gaozong personally composed supplemental reed-pipe odes, six stanzas.
translations.idiomatic: Village drinking ceremony—Gaozong personally composed supplemental reed-pipe odes, six stanzas.

sentences.zh: 南陔我逝南陔，言陟其岵。

translations.literal: Nanling: I go to Nanling; say I climb that hill.
translations.idiomatic: Nanling: I go to Nanling; say I climb that hill.

sentences.zh: 昔我行役，瞻望有父。

translations.literal: When of old I went on campaign; I looked back and had a father.
translations.idiomatic: When of old I went on campaign; I looked back and had a father.

sentences.zh: 欲養無由，風木何補。

translations.literal: I wished to nurture him but had no way; wind and tree—what remedy?
translations.idiomatic: I wished to nurture him but had no way; wind and tree—what remedy?

sentences.zh: 我逝南陔，言陟其屺。

translations.literal: I go to Nanling; say I climb that mound.
translations.idiomatic: I go to Nanling; say I climb that mound.

sentences.zh: 今我行役，瞻望有母。

translations.literal: Now I go on campaign; I look back and have a mother.
translations.idiomatic: Now I go on campaign; I look back and have a mother.

sentences.zh: 母也倚閭，歸則寧止。

translations.literal: Mother leans on the door; when I return—then peace.
translations.idiomatic: Mother leans on the door; when I return—then peace.

sentences.zh: 南陔有筍，籜實巳之。

translations.literal: Nanling has shoots; the sheaths and fruit already formed.
translations.idiomatic: Nanling has shoots; the sheaths and fruit already formed.

sentences.zh: 孱孱孩提，敦噢咻之。

translations.literal: Tiny, tiny infants; warmly hush and soothe them.
translations.idiomatic: Tiny, tiny infants; warmly hush and soothe them.

sentences.zh: 慎爾溫凊，節爾旨餚。

translations.literal: Care for your warmth and coolness; regulate your fine delicacies.
translations.idiomatic: Care for your warmth and coolness; regulate your fine delicacies.

sentences.zh: 今爾不養，日月其惂。

translations.literal: Now you do not nurture; sun and moon grow late.
translations.idiomatic: Now you do not nurture; sun and moon grow late.

sentences.zh: 白華有白者華，不汙纖塵。

translations.literal: Baihua: There are white flowers; they do not stain fine dust.
translations.idiomatic: Baihua: There are white flowers; they do not stain fine dust.

sentences.zh: 咨爾士兮，宜修其身。

translations.literal: I admonish you, gentleman; you should cultivate your person.
translations.idiomatic: I admonish you, gentleman; you should cultivate your person.

sentences.zh: 不修其身，乃貽羞於二人。

translations.literal: If you do not cultivate your person; you bring shame to two men.
translations.idiomatic: If you do not cultivate your person; you bring shame to two men.

sentences.zh: 有白者華，婉茲靜好。

translations.literal: There are white flowers; gentle and quiet and good.
translations.idiomatic: There are white flowers; gentle and quiet and good.

sentences.zh: 咨爾女兮，宜修婦道。

translations.literal: I admonish you, lady; you should cultivate wifely conduct.
translations.idiomatic: I admonish you, lady; you should cultivate wifely conduct.

sentences.zh: 不修婦道，乃貽羞於二老。

translations.literal: If you do not cultivate wifely conduct; you bring shame to two elders.
translations.idiomatic: If you do not cultivate wifely conduct; you bring shame to two elders.

sentences.zh: 白華匪玉，涅而不緇。

translations.literal: White flowers are not jade; blackened yet not stained.
translations.idiomatic: White flowers are not jade; blackened yet not stained.

sentences.zh: 白華匪蘭，芬乃勝之。

translations.literal: White flowers are not orchid; fragrance surpasses it.
translations.idiomatic: White flowers are not orchid; fragrance surpasses it.

sentences.zh: 我擷白華，載詠載思。

translations.literal: I pluck white flowers; chant and think, chant and think.
translations.idiomatic: I pluck white flowers; chant and think, chant and think.

sentences.zh: 白華匪玉，質玉之令。

translations.literal: White flowers are not jade; quality—jade's command.
translations.idiomatic: White flowers are not jade; quality—jade's command.

sentences.zh: 白華匪蘭，臭蘭之淨。

translations.literal: White flowers are not orchid; scent—orchid's purity.
translations.idiomatic: White flowers are not orchid; scent—orchid's purity.

sentences.zh: 我擷白華，載思載詠。

translations.literal: I pluck white flowers; think and chant, think and chant.
translations.idiomatic: I pluck white flowers; think and chant, think and chant.

sentences.zh: 華黍瞻彼阪田，厥黍始華。

translations.literal: Huatai: Behold that hillside field; its millet first flowers.
translations.idiomatic: Huatai: Behold that hillside field; its millet first flowers.

sentences.zh: 胝足胼手，嗟嗟我農夫。

translations.literal: Soles calloused, hands blistered; alas, alas—our farmers.
translations.idiomatic: Soles calloused, hands blistered; alas, alas—our farmers.

sentences.zh: 瞻彼阪田，黍華以秀。

translations.literal: Behold that hillside field; millet flowers to show ear.
translations.idiomatic: Behold that hillside field; millet flowers to show ear.

sentences.zh: 胼手胝足，惟勤斯殖茂。

translations.literal: Hands blistered, soles calloused; only diligence makes it lush.
translations.idiomatic: Hands blistered, soles calloused; only diligence makes it lush.

sentences.zh: 華有不秀矣，秀有不實矣，其雨其雨矣，杲杲日出矣，惄予愁之恤矣。

translations.literal: Some have not flowered; some flowered but bear no grain; may it rain, may it rain; bright bright the sun comes out; I am distressed and grieve—pity.
translations.idiomatic: Some have not flowered; some flowered but bear no grain; may it rain, may it rain; bright bright the sun comes out; I am distressed and grieve—pity.

sentences.zh: 由庚由庚便便，東西朔南。

translations.literal: Yougeng: Yougeng, easy and smooth; east, west, north, south.
translations.idiomatic: Yougeng: Yougeng, easy and smooth; east, west, north, south.

sentences.zh: 六符調燮，八風節宣。

translations.literal: Six talismans harmonized; eight winds regulated.
translations.idiomatic: Six talismans harmonized; eight winds regulated.

sentences.zh: 由庚容容，朔南西東。

translations.literal: Yougeng, abundant; north, south, west, east.
translations.idiomatic: Yougeng, abundant; north, south, west, east.

sentences.zh: 惟敬與勤，百王道同。

translations.literal: Only reverence and diligence; hundred kings' Way the same.
translations.idiomatic: Only reverence and diligence; hundred kings' Way the same.

sentences.zh: 由庚廓廓，東西南朔。

translations.literal: Yougeng, vast; east, south, west, north.
translations.idiomatic: Yougeng, vast; east, south, west, north.

sentences.zh: 先憂而憂，後樂而樂。

translations.literal: First worry, then worry; later joy, then joy.
translations.idiomatic: First worry, then worry; later joy, then joy.

sentences.zh: 由庚恢恢，南朔東西。

translations.literal: Yougeng, grand; south, north, east, west.
translations.idiomatic: Yougeng, grand; south, north, east, west.

sentences.zh: 皇極孰建，惟德之依。

translations.literal: Imperial apex who establishes; only virtue to rely on.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial apex who establishes; only virtue to rely on.

sentences.zh: 崇丘澗松童童，蛙黽鄰兮。

translations.literal: Chongqiu: Stream pines, lush; frogs and toads are neighbors.
translations.idiomatic: Chongqiu: Stream pines, lush; frogs and toads are neighbors.

sentences.zh: 丘草萋萋，盪青雲兮。

translations.literal: Hill grass lush; surging through blue clouds.
translations.idiomatic: Hill grass lush; surging through blue clouds.

sentences.zh: 凡百君子，慎乃託身兮。

translations.literal: Every hundred gentlemen; careful how you entrust yourself.
translations.idiomatic: Every hundred gentlemen; careful how you entrust yourself.

sentences.zh: 澗松童童，澗則卑兮。

translations.literal: Stream pines lush; the stream then low.
translations.idiomatic: Stream pines lush; the stream then low.

sentences.zh: 丘草萋萋，丘則崎兮。

translations.literal: Hill grass lush; the hill then steep.
translations.idiomatic: Hill grass lush; the hill then steep.

sentences.zh: 凡百君子，審所依兮。

translations.literal: Every hundred gentlemen; examine what you rely on.
translations.idiomatic: Every hundred gentlemen; examine what you rely on.

sentences.zh: 有崇者丘，物無不遂。

translations.literal: There is a lofty hill; things none do not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: There is a lofty hill; things none do not succeed.

sentences.zh: 有卓者道，愚無不智。

translations.literal: There is an outstanding Way; the foolish none not wise.
translations.idiomatic: There is an outstanding Way; the foolish none not wise.

sentences.zh: 資生育德，永植毋替。

translations.literal: Nurture and give birth to virtue; forever plant—do not cease.
translations.idiomatic: Nurture and give birth to virtue; forever plant—do not cease.

sentences.zh: 由儀在上曰天，在下曰地。

translations.literal: Youyi: Above is called heaven; below is called earth.
translations.idiomatic: Youyi: Above is called heaven; below is called earth.

sentences.zh: 君君臣臣，父父子子。

translations.literal: Lord and lord, minister and minister; father and father, son and son.
translations.idiomatic: Lord and lord, minister and minister; father and father, son and son.

sentences.zh: 在下曰地，在上曰天。

translations.literal: Below is called earth; above is called heaven.
translations.idiomatic: What lies below we call earth; what rises above we call heaven.

sentences.zh: 父父子子，君君臣臣。

translations.literal: Father and father, son and son; lord and lord, minister and minister.
translations.idiomatic: Each father is a father, each son a son; each ruler a ruler, each minister a minister.

sentences.zh: 由其儀矣，物則熙矣。

translations.literal: Because of its ceremony; things then bright and prosperous.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite is rightly performed, the ten thousand things flourish in light.

sentences.zh: 儀其由矣，物則休矣。

translations.literal: Ceremony is thereby; things then rest and still.
translations.idiomatic: Where the rite finds its source, all things settle into calm repose.
